18.name_en: King Oyster Mushrooms in Soy Milk Sauce
18.ingredients_en: King oyster mushrooms: 100 g; olive oil: 10 g. Sauce: soy milk 20 g, heavy cream 10 g, 1/2 Cheongyang chili, black pepper. To serve: baby greens 20 g.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the mushrooms into thick strips and sauté them in olive oil until golden.
2. Simmer the soy milk, cream, sliced chili, and pepper gently over low heat.
3. Add the mushrooms to the sauce, toss until evenly coated, and serve with baby greens.

19.ingredients_en: White beech mushrooms: 65 g; yellow bell pepper: 5 g; red bell pepper: 5 g; canola oil: 3 g.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the bell-pepper seeds and cut the peppers to match the size of the mushrooms.
2. Heat the canola oil in a pan and sauté the white beech mushrooms.
3. When the mushrooms begin to soften, add the peppers and stir-fry briefly. Transfer to a plate.

21.ingredients_en:
•Required ingredients: eggplant (15g), king oyster mushroom (15g), shiitake mushroom (10g)
•Peanut sauce: Peanut powder (5g), minced garlic (2g), sesame oil (2g), low-salt soy sauce (1g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the stem of the eggplant and cut it into pieces.
2. Slice the king oyster mushrooms into long strips, remove the stems from the shiitake mushrooms, and slice them flat.
3. Blanch the eggplants and mushrooms in boiling water, then cool them in cold water.
4. Mix the peanut sauce ingredients to make peanut sauce.
5. Remove the moisture from the blanched eggplant and mushrooms, place them in a bowl, and finish with peanut sauce.

28.ingredients_en:
Shrimp Tofu and Egg Stew
75g (3/4) soft tofu, 20g (5) cocktail shrimp, 30g (1/2) egg, 13g (1 tablespoon) fresh cream, 5g (1 teaspoon) sugar, 5g (1 teaspoon) unsalted butter
garnish
10 g spinach (3 stalks)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Blanch the cleaned shrimp in boiling water and take them out.a
2. Put soft tofu, eggs, fresh cream, and unsalted butter dissolved in sugar in a mixer, then mix with shrimp (1) and place in a bowl.b
3. Finely chop the spinach, sprinkle it in the mixture bowl (2), place it in a steamer, and steam it over medium heat for about 10 minutes.c

29.ingredients_en: For 1 serving: Korean chives 50 g; raw soybean flour 7 g. Sauce: low-sodium soy sauce 3 g, chopped green onion 5 g, minced garlic 2 g, gochugaru 2 g, cooking syrup 2 g, sesame oil 2 g, and sesame seeds.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash and drain the chives, cut them into 5 cm lengths, and toss evenly with the soybean flour.
2. Line a steamer with cloth, add the chives, and steam just until bright green and tender.
3. Mix all sauce ingredients. Place the steamed chives in a serving bowl and serve the sauce alongside.

32.name_en: Soft tofu with apple sauce and cucumber salad
32.ingredients_en:
●Spicy cucumber:
70g (1/3) cucumber, 10g (1 tablespoon) chopped peanuts
●Soft Tofu Apple Sauce: 
40g soft tofu (1/8 bag), 50g apple (1/3)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Put the apple and soft tofu in a blender and grind them finely to make the sauce.
2. Wash the cucumber by rubbing it with salt, cut it in half, remove the seeds, and slice it diagonally.
3. Add the soft tofu apple sauce to the sliced ​​cucumbers, mix, and finish by sprinkling chopped peanuts.

33.name_en: Dried Pollack Soup with Apple and Shrimp
33.ingredients_en:
Northern soup
25g pollack (15 pieces), 10g shrimp (3 pieces), 30g apple (1/5 piece), 40g onion (1/4 piece),
20g (2 pieces) shiitake mushrooms, 300ml (1½ cups) water

steps_en.instruction: 2. Tear the dried dried pollack into small pieces by hand and rinse in cold water. Cut the onion, shiitake mushrooms, and apple into strips. Insert a skewer into two or three joints on the shrimp's back to remove the intestines, then rinse.
3. Boil pollack, shrimp, shiitake mushrooms, and onions in cold water for about 20 minutes, then add apples to remove the bitter taste of pollack.
5. Serve in a bowl.

36.name_en: Dried Pollack Soup with Low-Sodium Doenjang
36.ingredients_en: Shredded dried pollack 15 g, bean sprouts 30 g, radish 30 g, low-sodium doenjang 10 g, water 300 ml, 1/2 Cheongyang chili, and minced garlic 2 g.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Rinse and drain the dried pollack. Trim and wash the bean sprouts, and slice the chili diagonally.
2. Add the water, pollack, and radish to a pot and bring to a boil. Remove any impurities and dissolve the doenjang into the broth.
3. Add the bean sprouts, garlic, and chili. Cover and boil until the sprouts are cooked through.

37.ingredients_en:
Miso soup
20g of tofu (2×2×2cm), 20g of oyster mushrooms (4 strands), 10g of potatoes (4×3×1cm), 10g of onions (2×1cm), 10g of green onions (5cm), 5g of soybean paste (1 teaspoon), 300ml (1½ cups) of water.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the potatoes and onions thinly and slice the oyster mushrooms and fry them in a heated pan.

2. Pour water into a pot, dissolve the soybean paste, add potatoes, onions, and tofu and boil until the ingredients become transparent. Take out the ingredients for the soybean paste soup, grind them in a blender, add them to the soybean paste soup, and boil once more.
3. Boil the roasted oyster mushrooms and green onions in the soup and place them in a bowl.

38.ingredients_en:
●Anchovy broth: 5g (3 fish) anchovies for soup, 1 sheet of kelp (5×1cm), 10g (2×1cm) onion, shiitake mushroom stem, 5g (1 teaspoon) soy sauce for soup, 300ml (1½ cups) water.
●Vegetable preparation: 20g (1 piece) bok choy, 20g (2 pieces) shiitake mushrooms, 2g (1/3 teaspoon) minced garlic.

steps_en.instruction:
1. Soak shiitake mushrooms and anchovies with heads and intestines removed in cold water,
Add kelp and onion and cook over medium heat for about 10 minutes.
Boil to make anchovy broth.
2. Remove the shiitake mushroom pillars, anchovies, kelp, and onions from the broth, then cut the shiitake mushrooms into pieces and cut the bok choy into 4cm pieces.
3. Add the prepared shiitake mushrooms and bok choy to the boiling broth, season with soy sauce, add garlic, and simmer for a while.

39.name_en: Cheonggukjang tofu black sesame cold soup
39.ingredients_en:
cold soup
120g of tofu (1/3 head), 70g of plain yogurt (1 piece), 8g of black sesame seeds (1⅔ teaspoon)
garnish
10g (1 tablespoon) Cheonggukjang powder

steps_en.instruction:
1. Pour water until the tofu is submerged.
Boil for about 5 to 7 minutes.a

2. Boiled tofu, plain yogurt, and black sesame seeds
Put it in the mixer and then put it in the refrigerator.
Store for about 1 hour.b

3. Put the cooled soup in a bowl and
Add Cheonggukjang powder on top.c

40.ingredients_en: Sweet potato 70 g, kabocha squash 30 g, milk 100 ml, sugar 2 g, and water 50 ml.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Steam the sweet potato and kabocha for 10–20 minutes. Peel, mash, and press through a sieve.
2. Combine the mashed vegetables, milk, and sugar in a pot. Bring to a gentle simmer while stirring.
3. Add the water a little at a time and simmer until the soup reaches a smooth, thick consistency.

62.ingredients_en:
●Grilled tofu: 70g (1/5 head) of tofu, 10g (2 teaspoons) starch, 2g (1/3 teaspoon) black sesame seeds, 5g (1 teaspoon) cooking oil, a little pepper
●Bulgogi seasoning: 3g (2/3 teaspoon) soy sauce, 3g (2/3 teaspoon) oligosaccharide, 3g (2/3 teaspoon) ginger juice, 30ml (2 tablespoons) water

steps_en.instruction:
1. Cut the tofu into 2.5×2.5×1cm pieces, drain, sprinkle with pepper, and evenly coat with starch powder.
Cover with cooking oil and fry on both sides until brown.
2. Boil soy sauce, oligosaccharide, ginger juice, and water in a frying pan to make bulgogi seasoning, then add the seasoning to the grilled tofu and simmer.
3. Put the tofu in a bowl and sprinkle black sesame seeds on top.

74.ingredients_en:
●Sedum salad: 90g sedum, 60g (7) mini king oyster mushrooms, a little sesame oil
●Lemon mayonnaise sauce: 10g (2 teaspoons) mayonnaise, 20g (1⅓ tablespoons) lemon juice, 5g (1/2) Cheongyang pepper, 5g (1/2) red pepper, a little sesame oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop Cheongyang pepper and red pepper and lightly fry them in sesame oil. Make sauce by adding mayonnaise and lemon juice to the roasted peppers.

2. Trim the sedum and soak it in cold water, and fry the king oyster mushrooms in a heated frying pan with sesame oil.
Bake well.

3. Drain the water from the sedum and add grilled king oyster mushrooms and lemon mayonnaise sauce.
Mix and place on a plate.

91.name_en: Grilled mushrooms and tofu tartare sauce
91.ingredients_en:
●Grilled mushrooms: 70g (7) king oyster mushrooms, 10g (2 teaspoons) olive oil
●Side: 10g chicory (3 stems)
●Tofu tartar sauce: 30g (1/4 teaspoon) soft tofu, 10g (2 teaspoons) chopped onion, 10g (2 teaspoons) chopped cucumber pickles, 2g (1/3 teaspoon) olive oil, 5g (1 teaspoon) vinegar, 3g (2/3 teaspoon) lemon juice, 3g (2/3 teaspoon) mustard, 2g (1/3 teaspoon) honey, a little white pepper.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Squeeze out the moisture from finely chopped onions and cucumber pickles.
2. Make tofu tartar sauce by adding chopped onion, chopped cucumber pickle, olive oil, mustard, pepper, honey, vinegar, and lemon juice to soft tofu.
3. Cut the king oyster mushrooms into 0.5cm-thick pieces and fry them until golden brown in a frying pan. Then, place the king oyster mushrooms and chicory on a plate and serve with the sauce.

111.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 160g somen, 4g (1 teaspoon) low-salt salt, 8g (1/2 teaspoon) vinegar
●Sauce: 200g (1/2) pomegranate
●Decoration: 4g (1 teaspoon) pine nuts, 4g (1 teaspoon) almonds, 4g (1 teaspoon) sunflower seeds, 4g (1 teaspoon) walnuts, 4g (1 teaspoon) pumpkin seeds, 20g (1/4) cucumber.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop pine nuts, almonds, sunflower seeds, walnuts, and pumpkin seeds.

2. Add low-salt salt and vinegar to boiling water, boil the somen, then drain through a sieve.
Subtract.

3. Grind the pomegranate with 600g of water in a blender and strain through a sieve to extract the juice. Put the noodles in a bowl, pour over the cooled pomegranate juice, and top with nuts and sliced ​​cucumbers as garnish.

113.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients
440g konjac, 70g black beans, 6g (1 teaspoon) roasted black sesame seeds, 6g (1 grain) walnuts
●Decoration
20g cucumber (1/8 piece), 50g tomato (1/2 piece), 50g egg (1 piece)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak black beans in cold water for 1 hour, then boil and cook to remove impurities. Grind black sesame seeds, bottled water, boiled beans, and walnuts in a blender and place in the freezer to create a soft texture.
2. Turn and peel the cucumber and slice it, cut the tomato into 1/8 size pieces, boil the egg and cut it in half.
3. Blanch the konjac in boiling water, rinse in cold water, place in a bowl, add bean water, and top with cucumber, tomato, and egg as garnish.

114.ingredients_en:
Main ingredients
4g dumpling skin (2 pieces), 100g broccoli (1/4 pieces), 100g bean sprouts, 20g shiitake mushrooms (2 pieces), 100g chicken breast, 2g sesame oil (1/2 teaspoon), 4g low-salt soy sauce (1 teaspoon), 0.5g salt, 0.1g pepper powder.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Mince broccoli, bean sprouts, shiitake mushrooms, and chicken breast. Season the minced chicken breast with salt and pepper.
2. Make dumpling filling by mixing chopped vegetables, chicken breast, sesame oil, and low-salt soy sauce.
3. Add the dumpling filling to the prepared dumpling skin, shape into dumplings, steam the dumplings in a steamer, and place in a bowl.

121.ingredients_en: 180g (1 cup) rice, 50g (1/2) spinach, 10g (5cm) yam, 150g (3/4 cup) soy milk, 1g salt, 8g (1½ teaspoon) butter, 1g pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Open the lid, blanch the spinach, and drain the water.
2. Grind the yam, spinach, and soy milk together and filter through a sieve.
3. Put butter in a heated pan and add 2 and rice over low heat to color the rice and season with salt and pepper.

124.ingredients_en:
Main ingredients
Garnish with 210g (1 cup) rice, 15g pollack, 15g (5cm) carrots, 15g (5cm) zucchini, 100g (2 pieces) eggs, 15g fern, 15g (2 pieces) shiitake mushrooms, 25g (2 tablespoons) snails, 5g (1 teaspoon) perilla oil.
5g baby vegetables, 5g edible flowers

steps_en.instruction:
1. Cut the carrots, shiitake mushrooms, and bracken into 5cm pieces, and cut the zucchini into 5cm pieces.
Cut into strips.
2. Cut the snail into 3 pieces and fry it in perilla oil along with the ingredients from 1. Divide the eggs into yellow and white halves, fry them and slice them.
3. Grind pollack to make pollack fluff. Put the rice in a bowl, add the prepared ingredients, and add baby vegetables, edible flowers, and pollack fluff to complete the dish.

125.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 140g (2/3 cup) brown rice, 140g (2/3 cup) glutinous rice, 35g (1/20) radish, 30g (2 pieces) shiitake mushrooms, 10g chard, 15g (1 tablespoon) olive oil, 15g (1 tablespoon) sesame oil.
●Stew: 50g (5 pieces) of Dupori (bandaengi), 15g (5cm) of kelp, 15g (1 tablespoon) of soy sauce.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash brown rice and glutinous rice, soak in water, and add dupori, kelp, and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce to the water to make broth.
2. Slice the radishes, shiitake mushrooms, and Swiss chard. Add olive oil to a pan, stir-fry the shredded radishes and shiitake mushrooms, then add sesame oil.
3. Add broth to soaked brown rice and glutinous rice, top with stir-fried radish and shiitake mushrooms, and finish with shredded chard.

127.ingredients_en:
420g rice (2 cups), 4g seaweed (1 sheet), 30g cabbage kimchi, 200g eggs (4 pieces),
Bacon 30g (3 pieces), sausage 30g (1 piece), spinach 70g, red pepper powder 20g (1 tablespoon), sesame oil 6g (1 teaspoon), garlic 6g (1 teaspoon)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop bacon and sausage, blanch them in boiling water and fry them in a pan. Rinse the chopped kimchi in water and fry it with red pepper powder.
2. Blanch and chop the spinach, season with sesame oil and minced garlic, fry and mince the egg.
3. Grill the seaweed with sesame oil, cut it lengthwise, and layer it with rice and the prepared ingredients.

131.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredient: 50g somen
●Broth: 3g (1/2 teaspoon) of seaweed, 25g (1/2) of hericaceae mushrooms, 17g (15cm) of kelp, 140g (1/2) of green onion, 150g of onion (1/2), 250g of radish (1/3), 150g of clam (3/4 cup), 35g of shepherd's purse, soy sauce. 30g (2 tablespoons)
●Decoration: 50g egg (1 piece), 20g green pepper (1 piece), 2g shredded pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Boil seaweed, hericaceae mushrooms, kelp, green onions, onions, and radishes in water for 10 minutes. Add strong-smelling moss clams and shepherd's purse and boil for 30 minutes. Add color with soy sauce.
2. Boil the somen separately.
3. Put the boiled somen in a bowl, pour in the broth, and top with ground beef, sliced ​​green peppers, and shredded peppers.

137.ingredients_en:
320g (1 head) of tofu, 300g (1½ cups) of rice water, 100g of pork, 140g of kimchi, 20g (1½ tablespoons) of soybean paste, 10g (1/2) of Cheongyang pepper, 5g (1/4) of red pepper,
10g (2cm) green onion, 5g (1 teaspoon) red pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add rice water to tofu and grind.
2. Slice the pork, wash the kimchi in water to remove the seasoning, and cut into 3×3cm pieces.

3. Stir-fry pork and kimchi together in a pot, then add soybean paste strained through a mesh net, the tofu from step 1, red pepper powder, Cheongyang pepper, and red pepper and boil. Add green onion to finish.

138.ingredients_en: 1g kelp, 10g tofu, 10g tteokguk rice cake, 10g spam (mild), 5g minced garlic, 20g radish, 15g kimchi, 10g (1/2 piece) sausage, 5g (1 teaspoon) beef stew, 5g onion, 15g (1 tablespoon) low-salt soybean paste, 5g bacon, 5g green onion, 5g Cheongyang pepper, red pepper 1g

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut kimchi, bacon, spam, sausage, onion, tofu, and radish into 0.5cm thick pieces.
2. Boil kelp and water to make kelp water.

3. Boil 300g of sausage, bacon, tofu, Spam, radish, beef stew, kimchi, and kelp water in a pot, then add low-salt soybean paste, onion, green onion, minced garlic, rice cake soup, and when the ingredients are all cooked, add red pepper and Cheongyang pepper.

140.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 5g (1/3) green pepper, 80g (1/3) soft tofu, 120g maesaengi, 120g mussels
●Broth: 20g (10cm) of kelp, 60g (10) of anchovies, 15g (1 tablespoon) of barley soybean paste.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the maesaengi and strain it through a sieve.
2. Make broth by adding kelp, anchovies, and barley soybean paste to 250g of water.
3. When the broth boils, add maesaengi, mussels, and soft tofu to the boil, then top with red pepper as a garnish.

150.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 10g (1/60) cabbage, 5g water parsley, 5g (1/2) red pepper, 5g (1 teaspoon) salt.
●Kimchi soup: 100g (1 piece) tangerine, 5g (1 teaspoon) red pepper powder, 10g (2 teaspoons) minced garlic, 5g (1 teaspoon) ginger juice.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the tangerine, grind it in a blender, and strain it.
2. Cut the cabbage into 3×3cm pieces, pickle them in salt, place them in a sieve, and cut the water parsley and red pepper into 3cm long pieces.

3. Make kimchi broth by adding red pepper powder, ginger juice, and minced garlic to tangerine juice. Pour kimchi broth into cabbage, water parsley, and red pepper and leave to age at room temperature for 2 days.

159.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 70g (1/10) cabbage, 10g (2 teaspoons) pomegranate juice, 5g (1/2 teaspoon) salt.
●Seasoning: 10g (3cm) of radish, 10g of water parsley, 10g (1 piece) of chives, 5g (1 teaspoon) of minced garlic, 5g (1 teaspoon) of minced ginger, 15g (1 tablespoon) of salted shrimp soup.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Pickle the cabbage in salt water for a day, then drain the water and juice the pomegranate.
2. Slice the radish, and cut the chives and water parsley into 4cm pieces.

3. Add radish greens, water parsley, chives, minced garlic, minced ginger, and salted shrimp soup to make the filling. Add the filling to the pickled cabbage and wrap it in a ball. It is completed by soaking the stuffed cabbage in pomegranate juice.

161.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 120g cod meat, 10g (1/10) red paprika, 10g (1/10) yellow paprika, 10g (1/10) green paprika, 10g golden enoki mushroom, 20g water parsley, 25g (2 tablespoons) flour
●Sauce: 20g (1⅓ tablespoons) citron syrup, 10g (2 teaspoons) balsamic vinegar, 10g (2 teaspoons) white wine
Garnish: 30g (1 piece) green onion

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add balsamic vinegar, white wine, and chopped yuzu greens and simmer to make sauce. Then, prepare and fillet the cod.
2. Chop green onion, green paprika, red paprika, and yellow paprika.

3. Dip the cod wrap in flour, roll it with green paprika, red paprika, yellow paprika, and golden enoki mushrooms, tie it with water parsley, steam it, sprinkle with sauce, and top with sliced ​​green onions.

162.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 10g (3cm) purple sweet potato, 10g (2cm) radish, 80g (1/4) pear, 200g (1/3) cabbage, 10g chives, 80g (1/3) apple, 10g (10cm) chives, 20g (1⅓ tablespoons) salt.
●Seasoning: 10g (2 teaspoons) non-glutinous rice, 50g (1/4 cup) starch syrup, 140g (1½ cups) yellow paprika

steps_en.instruction: 1. Grind the yellow paprika, pass it through a sieve, make rice paste with non-glutinous rice, mix with the yellow paprika juice, and add starch syrup to make the seasoning.
2. Pickle the cabbage in salt water and wash the pickled cabbage in cold water to remove the salt.
3. Place shredded purple sweet potatoes, radishes, chives, chives, apples, and pears on the cabbage with the salt removed, add seasoning, and leave to age for 3 days.

163.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 1000g cockles, 100g chives (2 bunches), 10g perilla leaves (10 pieces), 100g paprika (1 piece)
●Sauce: 15g (1 tablespoon) soybean paste, 5g (1 teaspoon) red pepper paste, 300g (1/2 cup) apple juice, 20g (1⅓ tablespoon) sesame oil, 15g (1 tablespoon) sesame seeds, 10g (2 teaspoons) minced garlic.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Make the sauce by adding soybean paste, red pepper paste, apple juice, sesame seeds, minced garlic, and sesame oil.
2. Soak the cockles in salt water for 30 minutes and then blanch them in boiling water for 10 minutes.
3. Cut the wild chives, perilla leaves, and paprika into 5cm pieces. Add the sauce to the cockles, wild chives, perilla leaves, and paprika and mix.

172.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 60g (10) garlic seeds, 200g salmon, 5g (1/2 teaspoon) cooking oil
●Sauce: 5g (1 teaspoon) black sesame seeds, 5g (1 teaspoon) Cheonggukjang powder, 20g (4 teaspoons) mayonnaise
Garnish: 5g jujube (1 piece)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Make sauce by mixing black sesame seeds, mayonnaise, and cheonggukjang powder.
2. Heat cooking oil in a pan and fry salmon and garlic bell peppers.

3. Spread garlic sprouts on a plate, top with salmon, sprinkle with sauce, and garnish with shredded jujube.
Garnish with jujube slices.

193.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 70g (1½ pieces) zucchini, 60g (3 pieces) button mushrooms, 70g (1/2 pieces) eggplant, 25g low-salt salami, 60g (1/3 pieces) apples
●Sauce: 40g (1/5) onion, 10g (2) garlic, 600g (3) tomatoes, 10g (2 teaspoons) sugar, 50g basil, 15g (1 tablespoon) red pepper paste.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop and fry the onion and garlic, add tomato pulp, sugar, basil, and mix with red pepper paste to make tomato sauce.
2. Chop the eggplant, button mushrooms, zucchini, and apples and blanch the salami.
3. Spread the tomato sauce on an oven pan, then layer the zucchini, eggplant, button mushrooms, and salami. Place in an oven preheated to 180°C and bake for 30 minutes.

215.ingredients_en:
Ingredients Sweet pumpkin (100g), onion (30g), stone pumpkin (35g), paprika (40g), eggplant (90g)
Tofu (50g), rice (180g), three namul (10g)
Seasoning: Minced garlic (5g), low-salt soybean paste (12g), pepper powder (0.3g), perilla oil (4g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Boil and mash the sweet pumpkin.

2. Dice onion, stone leaf, paprika, and eggplant.
Slice and mash the tofu.

3. Add minced garlic, onion, and stone parchment paper to the pan.
Stir-fry and add tofu until the moisture disappears.
Stir-fry until cooked and add eggplant and paprika.
Add and stir-fry

4. Add rice, low-salt soybean paste, and pepper powder.
Stir-fry and add perilla oil once more.
Stir-fry.

5. Put mashed pumpkin in a bowl and
Finish with sesame seeds.

216.ingredients_en:
Ingredients Rice (80g), peas (10g), chicken (100g), jujube (10g), fresh ginseng (20g)
Onion (20g), Carrot (10g)
Seasoned turmeric powder (3g), cooking wine (15g)

steps_en.instruction:
1. Soak the rice for about 30 minutes, then dissolve turmeric powder in an equal amount of water and mix it with the peas.
Put it in and cook it.

2. Wash the chicken thoroughly and place in boiling water.
Blanch briefly to remove fat and then cut into small pieces.
Slice and marinate in cooking wine with jujube and fresh ginseng.
Eliminates unpleasant odors.
3. Chop the onions and carrots into small pieces.

4. Add oil to the pan and leave to marinate.
Stir-fry chicken, carrots, and onions

5. Add turmeric rice and stir-fry.
Finish.

217.ingredients_en:
Ingredients Rice (80g), peas (10g), chicken (100g), jujube (10g), fresh ginseng (20g)
Onion (20g), Carrot (10g)
Seasoned turmeric powder (3g), cooking wine (15g)

steps_en.instruction:
1. Add rice and kelp and mix with the same amount of rice.
Pour water to make the rice soft
build

2. Chop the onion coarsely, and chop the chives and peppers.
Cut into small pieces and eat squid and octopus
Cut into good sized pieces.

3. Add perilla oil to a heated pan and chop it.
Stir-fry garlic until fragrant.

4. Add seaweed and stir-fry.
Add squid, octopus, shrimp meat, and onion.
Stir-fry.

5. Add rice and stir-fry with salt.
Add perilla seed powder and stir-fry.

6. Finely chopped chives, Cheongyang pepper, red
Add pepper and fry a little more
Finish.

218.ingredients_en:
Ingredients Rice (100g), brown rice (30g), potato (30g), sweet potato (15g), onion (15g), lotus root (15g)
Carrot (15g), Zucchini (15g), Burdock (15g), Garlic (3g), Spinach (5g), Chamnamul (10g)
Perilla leaves (5g), water parsley (5g)
Broth kelp (2g)
Seasoned raw cheonggukjang (30g), perilla seed powder (2g), olive oil (10g), perilla oil (8g)

steps_en.instruction:
1. Wash and soak rice and brown rice in water.
Then cook the rice until soft.

2. Potato, sweet potato, burdock, onion, carrot,
Cut the zucchini and lotus root into small pieces,
Chop the garlic.

3. Coarsely chop spinach, chamnamul, and perilla leaves.
Slice, and cut the water parsley into 2.5cm long pieces.

4. Make broth by steeping kelp in water (50g).
After serving, add cheonggukjang and mix well.
Add perilla seed powder, stir well and simmer.
Make cheonggukjang sauce.

5. Add olive oil and perilla oil to the pan.
Stir-fry onion and garlic over low heat
Potato, sweet potato, burdock, lotus root, carrot,
Add zucchini and stir-fry together.

6. Pour rice and cheonggukjang sauce and fill about 80%.
Stir-fry spinach, chamnamul, and water parsley
Add and stir-fry once more and shredded perilla leaves.
Finish by raising it.

219.ingredients_en:
Fried rice (100g), asparagus (5g), king oyster mushroom (10g), egg (40g)
Octopus (20g), shrimp meat (20g), octopus (15g)
Stir-fried water parsley and red pepper paste radish (20g), burdock (10g), water parsley (5g),

steps_en.instruction:
1. Wash the rice, strain and leave for at least 1 hour.
After soaking, pour the same amount of water and cook the rice.
build

2. Cut asparagus and king oyster mushrooms into small pieces.
Dice radish, burdock, and water parsley
Chop.

3. Heat a pan with cooking oil (10g) over medium heat.
Heat it, add eggs and scramble.
Stir-fry.

682.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 30g amaranth sprouts, salt water (100g water, 3g salt) - Seasoning sauce: 1.5g canary fish sauce, 1.5g soy sauce, 15g water, 1.7g red pepper powder, 6g plum juice, 1g sesame seeds, 2.5g minced green onions, 1g minced garlic

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash purslane.
2. Soak the washed purslane in salt water and lightly pickle it.
3. Rinse the pickled purslane and strain it.
4. Mix all seasoning ingredients to make seasoning sauce.
5. Add the seasoning sauce to the purslane and lightly season.
6. Place in a bowl and finish.

684.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 70g butterbur, 2g perilla oil, 5g chives, 100g water - Seasoning: 6g perilla seed powder, 3g soup soy sauce, 2.5g minced green onion, 1g minced garlic, 0.5g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the butterbur stems, blanch them and peel them.
2. Soak the blanched butterbur stalks in cold water for 1-2 hours to remove the bitter taste.
3. Season butterbur with seasoning.
4. Put perilla oil in a pan and fry the seasoned butterbur stalks.
5. Add half a cup of water and boil until the soup thickens.
6. Cool the finished butterbur greens and keep them cold in the refrigerator before eating.

685.name_en: Stir-fried watermelon peel and green pepper
685.ingredients_en: 50g watermelon rind, 15g green pepper, 5g red pepper, 4g grape seed oil, 1g salt (0.5g when pickling, 0.5g when seasoning)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the green part of the watermelon rind and thinly slice it.
2. Sprinkle salt on the shredded watermelon rind, lightly pickle it, and squeeze out the moisture.
3. Cut the pepper into two lengthwise and remove the seeds.
4. Thickly chop the seeded pepper.
5. Add oil to the pan and lightly fry the watermelon peel and pepper.
6. Season with salt and finish.

689.name_en: Abalone nutritional rice and chive seasoning
689.ingredients_en: Nutritional abalone rice: 90g rice, 40g abalone meat, 13g button mushrooms, 15g shiitake mushrooms, 15g carrots, 5g dried kelp, 400g water - Chive seasoning: 5g kelp broth, 5g chives, 5g soy sauce, 2.5g green onions, 2.5g minced garlic, 0.5g sesame oil, 0.5g sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add dried kelp to 2 cups of water to make about 1 and a half cups of kelp broth.
2. Finely chop the kelp and abalone meat.
3. Cut shiitake mushrooms, button mushrooms, and carrots into 0.5-0.7cm dice.
4. Wash the rice, add ingredients 2 and 3, pour in 1 and a half cups of kelp broth, soak for about 30 minutes, and then cook the rice.
5. Chop chives and green onions and make seasoning sauce by adding sesame oil, minced garlic, sesame seeds, kelp broth, and soy sauce.
6. Add chive seasoning to abalone nutritious rice.

690.name_en: Swiss Chard Rice Wraps with Anchovy and Nut Ssamjang
690.ingredients_en: Modern ssambap: 70g rice, 10g brown rice, 10g barley rice, 50g Swiss chard, 400g water, 2g dried anchovy, 2.5g dried kelp, - Anchovy nut ssamjang: 10g kelp broth, 3g onion, 2.5g soybean paste, 2.5g green onion, 2.5g red pepper paste, 2.5g small anchovy, walnut 2.5g, pine nuts 2.5g, peanuts 2.5g, minced garlic 2.5g, plum juice 2.5g

steps_en.instruction: 1. Boil dried anchovies and dried kelp in 2/3 cup of water to make soup. Steam Swiss chard on a trivet using this heat.
2. For the soup, chop the kelp into small pieces and cook it with rice, brown rice, and barley rice.
3. Lightly fry and chop the small anchovies in a pan without adding oil. Chop the nuts with a knife.
4. Chop onions and green onions.
5. Make anchovy nut ssamjang by mixing red pepper paste, soybean paste, nuts, onions, minced garlic, plum juice, green onions, and anchovy kelp broth.
6. Put about 30g (1 spoon) of rice on top of chard, add about 5g of anchovy nut ssamjang and wrap with chard leaves.

693.name_en: Watermelon Bibim Noodles and Watermelon Gochujang Sauce
693.ingredients_en: 20g minced meat, 20g pumpkin leaves, 15g chives, 15g eggs, 300g water, 8g soybean paste, 5g dried anchovies, 2.5g dried kelp, 5g green onions, 5g minced garlic.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash carrots, red cabbage, perilla leaves, and cabbage and cut them into 4-5cm pieces.
2. Cut the flesh and white part of the watermelon into 4-5cm pieces.
3. Place the somen in boiling water. When it boils, add a small amount of cold water and boil again. When it is fully cooked, quickly rinse it in cold water and place it on a strainer.
4. For the eggs, fry the yellow and white fat and cut it into strips.

5. Grate watermelon and onion on a grater and add red pepper paste, red pepper powder, sesame oil, chopped green onion, minced garlic, vinegar, plum juice, and sesame seeds to make watermelon red pepper paste seasoning sauce.
6. Mix somen with watermelon red pepper paste seasoning sauce and top with crust.

695.ingredients_en: 100g rice, 25g zucchini, 10g onion, 5g green pepper, 15g red pepper paste, 50g Korean wheat flour, 50g water, 1.5g brown rice oil, 1g black sesame, 1g sesame oil, 0.2g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Grind the onion and finely chop the zucchini and green pepper.
2. Dissolve red pepper paste in 1/2 cup of water, add Korean wheat flour and mix evenly.
3. Add the ingredients from 1 to 2 and knead.
4. Add brown rice oil to the pan and fry the ingredients from step 3 in a thin layer.
5. Add sesame oil, black sesame seeds, and salt to the rice and season.
6. Spread the seasoned rice on the zucchini paste rice cake thinly, roll it up, and cut it into 2-3cm long pieces.

696.ingredients_en: 70g rice, 20g chives, 20g bracken, 5g red paprika, 5g yellow paprika, 3g sesame oil, 1g minced garlic, 0.7g salt, 0.5g sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the rice and then cook it.
2. Boil the bracken in boiling water, and lightly blanch the finely chopped paprika in the bracken boiling water.
3. While boiling the bracken, add the scallions and blanch them together.
4. Finely chop the bracken and bracken.
5. Add sesame oil, garlic, salt, and sesame seeds to the paprika, fern, and chives and season.
6. Season the rice with sesame oil, sesame seeds, and salt, then mix the ingredients in step 4 to make rice balls.

698.ingredients_en: 40g tofu, 10g wild chives, 20g cabbage kimchi, 2g red bell pepper, 2.5g chopped green onion, 2.5g minced garlic, 1g sugar, 1g sesame oil, 0.5g sesame seeds, 0.5g red pepper powder, 0.2g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the tofu into 5cm × 1.5cm × 1cm pieces.
2. Cook the sliced ​​tofu in a pan without adding oil.
3. Cut the wild chives into pieces about 2cm in size.
4. Squeeze out the water from the cabbage kimchi and cut it into thin strips of about 2cm.
5. Slice the red bell pepper into thin strips of about 2cm and season with 3, 4, green onions, garlic, sugar, sesame oil, sesame seeds, red pepper powder, and salt.
6. Serve the tofu with the kimchi salad from 5.

699.name_en: Chicken breast and vegetable salad with strawberry sauce
699.ingredients_en: 50g chicken breast, 20g cherry tomatoes, 15g lettuce, 10g broccoli, 5g red cabbage, 3g yellow paprika, 3g red paprika, 50g yogurt, 40g strawberries, 2g walnuts, 0.5g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Blanch chicken breast in hot boiling water.
2. Lightly blanch broccoli in the chicken breast boiling water.
3. Tear the chicken breast into small pieces along the grain of the meat.
4. Tear the lettuce into small pieces by hand, cut the red cabbage and paprika into 2cm pieces, and cut the cherry tomatoes in half.
5. Grate the strawberries and add yogurt, walnuts, and salt to make the dressing.
6. Put ingredients 2 and 3 on a plate and serve with strawberry dressing.

701.ingredients_en: 50g soaked radish radish, 180g rice, 18g soybean paste, 2.5g minced garlic, 1.25g ginger juice, 12g grape seed oil, 30g fresh cream, 3g butter

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak radish greens in cold water to remove odor.
2. Squeeze out the moisture from the radish greens.
3. Cut the drained radish greens into appropriate sizes.
4. Season the radish with soybean paste, minced garlic, and ginger juice.
5. Put grape seed oil in a pan, add seasoned radish greens and fry.
6. Add rice and stir-fry, then add fresh cream and butter and stir-fry for a moment more to combine the flavors.

704.ingredients_en: 70g crab (30g crab meat), 20g cabbage, 20g tomato, 6g soybean paste, 5g green onion, 3g dried kelp, 2.5g minced garlic, 200g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Clean the crab and cut it into bite-size pieces.
2. Add dried kelp and crab to 1 cup of water and boil to make ⅔ cup of broth.
3. Wash the cabbage and tomatoes and cut them into 1cm x 1cm pieces.
4. Wash the green onions and slice them diagonally.
5. Remove the crab from the broth and remove the flesh.
6. Dissolve the soybean paste into the broth, add cabbage and tomatoes, boil for a while, and finish by adding the spread crab meat, green onions, and minced garlic.

705.ingredients_en:
•Required ingredients: Burdock (25g), green onion (2g), water (300g)
Seasoning: perilla seed powder (2g), minced garlic (2g), perilla oil (1g), soy sauce (3g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the burdock.
2. Slice the peeled burdock into 4cm long pieces.
3. Put water and burdock in a pot and boil for 3 to 5 minutes.
4. Strain the boiled burdock through a sieve.
5. Cut the green onions diagonally.
6. Add boiled burdock, trimmed green onions, and seasoning ingredients and mix well to finish.

706.ingredients_en: 50g cocktail shrimp, 80g tofu, 10g chives, 8g shiitake mushrooms, 1g salt, 0.25g pepper, 75g dumpling skin, 1.5g soy sauce, 0.75g vinegar, 5g water, 0.4g red pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Mash the tofu with the back of a knife, wrap it in a cotton cloth, and squeeze out the moisture.
2. Finely chop the shrimp, chives, and shiitake mushrooms.
3. Make the filling by adding minced shrimp, chives, shiitake mushrooms, salt, and pepper to the tofu.
4. Place 10g of filling on each dumpling skin, place the shrimp tails on the outside, and fold them in.
5. Place a wet cotton cloth in the steamer, add dumplings, and steam for 7 minutes.
6. Serve with seasoning sauce.

709.ingredients_en: 50g taro, 15g beef brisket, 10g cabbage, 2.5g green onion, 1.25g minced garlic, 1.7g red pepper powder, 9g soybean paste, 180g water, 1g sesame oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the taro with a potato knife and cut it into 3-4 pieces.
2. Cut the beef and cabbage into 5mm wide pieces and cut the green onions diagonally.
3. Soak the taro in light salt water (1 cup of water + 1g of salt).
4. Fry the beef and minced garlic in sesame oil, and when the aroma comes out, add red pepper powder and fry for a while more.
5. Pour water into the stir-fried meat and add soybean paste.
6. When the soup boils, add cabbage, taro, and green onions and boil for a while.

711.ingredients_en: Grilled cutlassfish: 50g cutlassfish, 4g brown rice oil, red pepper paste seasoning: 5g red pepper paste, 5g onion, 3g green onion, 2g minced garlic, 2g soy sauce, 2g plum juice, 1g red pepper powder, 0.5g minced ginger, 0.1g sesame seeds, 0.3g pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the scales of the cutlassfish, trim it, cut it into pieces, and cut it 3-4 times.
2. Chop the green onions.
3. Make seasoning sauce by mixing red pepper paste, onion, green onion, minced garlic, soy sauce, plum juice, red pepper powder, minced ginger, and pepper powder.
4. Put brown rice oil in a pan and grill the cutlassfish on both sides.
5. Apply red pepper paste seasoning on the grilled cutlassfish and grill.
6. Finish by sprinkling sesame seeds.

713.ingredients_en: 50g mackerel, 2g soybean oil, 2g onion peel, 5g onion, 3g Japanese soybean paste, 2g mayonnaise, 0.3g vinegar, 3.75g cooking wine, 1.25g ginger juice, 3.75g kelp broth.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the intestines of the mackerel.
2. Cut the mackerel with the intestines removed in half lengthwise and cut each into two pieces.
3. Mix all the seasoning ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
4. Apply seasoning sauce to mackerel and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
5. Lightly scrape off the marinade from the mackerel.
6. Put oil in a pan and fry mackerel on top of the onion skin and thinly sliced ​​onions.

715.ingredients_en: 70g octopus, 30g broccoli, 60g cherry tomatoes, 5g flour, 25g onion, 2g garlic, 3g olive oil, 0.5g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the octopus by kneading it with flour.
2. Cut the washed octopus into 5cm long pieces.
3. Cut the garlic into slices, the onion into 3cm squares, and the broccoli into bite-sized pieces.
4. Add olive oil to the pan and fry the garlic until fragrant.
5. Add onions and cherry tomatoes and cook slowly over low heat until the tomatoes soften.
6. Add broccoli and octopus, stir-fry, season with salt and serve on a plate.

717.ingredients_en: 50g octopus, 15g sedum, 10g cucumber, 5g yellow paprika, 5g red paprika, 5g onion, 9g red pepper paste, 6g vinegar, 5g plum juice, 5g minced green onion, 2.5g minced garlic, 1g sesame seeds, 1g red pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the sedum into bite-size pieces.
2. Cut the cucumber and paprika into 4-5cm pieces.
3. Blanch the octopus in boiling water.
4. Cut the blanched octopus into 4-5cm pieces.
5. Make red pepper paste seasoning by adding red pepper paste, vinegar, plum juice, green onions, garlic, sesame seeds, and red pepper powder.
6. Place 1, 2, and 4 on a plate and add the red pepper paste seasoning from 5.

719.name_en: Perilla Seed Soup with Dried Acorn Jelly and Mushrooms
719.ingredients_en: 30g dried acorn jelly (50g soaked), 5g shiitake mushrooms, 5g oyster mushrooms, 5g perilla seed powder, 3g dried anchovies, 3g dried kelp, 2g green onions, 2.5g minced garlic, 1g soup soy sauce, 0.5g salt, 300g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add dried anchovies and dried kelp to 1 and a half cups of water, add about 1 cup of anchovy and kelp broth, and scoop out the kelp and cut it into strips.
2. Soak dried acorn jelly in water and cut into 5cm long pieces.
3. Slice the shiitake mushrooms into 5cm long pieces and thinly slice the oyster mushrooms into 5cm long pieces.
4. Wash the green onions and slice them diagonally.
5. Add acorn jelly, shiitake mushrooms, and oyster mushrooms to 1 cup of anchovy kelp broth and boil for a while.
6. Add perilla seed powder, green onion, minced garlic, and kelp to 5 and season with soy sauce and salt.

720.ingredients_en: 40g radish, 30g shrimp (prawn), 3g green onion, 3g minced garlic, 2g red pepper powder, 2g soy sauce, 1g sugar, 2g sesame oil, 0.2g sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the radish and cut it into 1cm × 4cm × 0.3cm pieces.
2. Remove the intestines from the back of the shrimp.
3. Wash the shrimp with the intestines removed by gently shaking them in salt water.
4. Put radish and shrimp in a steaming steamer and steam them together.
5. Peel the steamed shrimp and cut them in half.
6. Mix the radish with green onions, minced garlic, red pepper powder, soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and sesame seeds, then add the shrimp from step 5 and mix.

721.ingredients_en: 70g sea croaker, 20g fern, 10g onion, 3g red pepper, 3g green pepper, 2.5g minced garlic, 1g minced ginger, 2g soup soy sauce, 1g sesame oil, 0.3g sesame seeds, 100g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the scales and fins of the sea croaker, make 3 to 4 slits on the front and back, and prepare so that the seasoning is well absorbed.
2. Cut the fern into approximately 4cm pieces.
3. Season the cut bracken with soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic.
4. Finely chop the onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
5. Put the seasoned bracken into a pot.
6. Pour water into the pot in step 5, add seaweed, onion, red pepper, green pepper, ginger, garlic, soup soy sauce, sesame seeds, and sesame oil and steam.

722.ingredients_en: 30g shiitake mushrooms, 20g minced beef sirloin, 3g onion, 2.5g green onion, 1.25g minced garlic, 3g soy sauce, 2g sugar, 1g sesame oil, 0.5g dried Cheongyang pepper.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the stems of shiitake mushrooms.
2. Chop the mushroom stems, onions, and green onions.
3. Crush the dried peppers.
4. Add steps 2 and 3 and the remaining seasoning to the meat and mix well.
5. Fill the shiitake mushrooms with seasoned meat.
6. Place a wet cotton cloth in the steamer and steam for 10 minutes.

723.ingredients_en: 60g pork, 20g chamnamul, 15g onion, 5g green onion, 3g whole garlic, 2g ginger, 0.5g pepper powder, 10g onion, 4g soy sauce, 4g vinegar, 3g sugar, 3g garlic, 1g red pepper powder, 1g olive oil, 0.5g sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Put 2 cups of water in a pot and boil pork, onion, green onion, whole garlic, ginger, and pepper powder.
2. Cut the boiled pork into pieces about 2cm × 3cm × 0.3cm.
3. Cut the chamnamul into bite-size pieces.
4. Chop the onion.
5. Make salad dressing by adding chopped onion, sugar, soy sauce, red pepper powder, olive oil, vinegar, garlic, and sesame seeds.
6. Place the pork from 2 and the chamnamul from 3 into a bowl and serve with salad dressing.

725.name_en: Stir-fried King Songi with Pine Nut Sauce
725.ingredients_en: 30g king oyster mushroom, 10g red paprika, 10g yellow paprika, 20g glutinous rice powder, 30g water, 0.25g salt, 4g olive oil, 5g pine nuts, 0.5g honey, 5g milk, 0.25g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice king oyster mushrooms and paprika thinly.
2. Add oil to a pan and lightly fry the shredded vegetables.
3. Mix glutinous rice powder, water, and salt to make glutinous rice dough.
4. Add oil to the pan and pour the dough into a round shape, spoonful at a time.
5. Add all sauce ingredients and place in a mixer.
6. Season the stir-fried vegetables with pine nut sauce and place a spoonful at a time on top of the glutinous rice pancakes.

729.ingredients_en: 10g kohlrabi, 3g carrots, 6g cucumber, 2g green pepper, 1g red pepper, 0.5g green onion, 0.5g salt, 60g water, 10g glutinous rice powder, 10g pear, 10g red onion, 1g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the kohlrabi, carrots, and cucumbers into strips.
2. Cut the pepper into rounds and cut the green onions into 3cm long pieces.
3. Lightly pickle the kohlrabi with salt.
4. Dissolve the glutinous rice in water, scoop out the glutinous rice paste, and cool.
5. Make soup by grinding pears and red onions into glutinous rice paste.
6. Add salt to the soup, season it, pour it over the sliced ​​vegetables, place it in a container, and cook.

737.ingredients_en: 50g rice powder, 25g potato, 20g mussel meat, 20g zucchini, 20g egg yolk, 5g onion, 5g chopped green onion, 3g dried anchovy, 2.5g red pepper, 2.5g green pepper, 2.5g minced garlic, 2g kelp, 2g soup soy sauce, 1g brown rice oil, 0.3g salt, water 250g

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add mussels, dried anchovies, dried kelp, and onions to 1 and a half cups of water, add 1 cup of anchovy and kelp broth, and scoop out the kelp and cut it into strips.
2. Peel the potatoes, steam them in a steamer and mash them.
3. Add rice flour, egg yolk, brown rice oil, and salt to the ingredients in 2 and knead to make about 10 bead-sized balls.
4. Peel the pumpkin and cut it into strips of about 2cm, and cut the green onion, red pepper, and green pepper diagonally.
5. When the anchovy and kelp soup boils, add the ongsimi. When it is cooked and floats, add the mussels, pumpkin, chopped green onions, minced garlic, and kelp and season with soy sauce.
6. Garnish with red and green peppers.

738.ingredients_en: 50g eggs, 30g rice (13g rice), 20g kimchi, 5g carrots, 5g onions, 5g green onions, 2g salted shrimp broth, 100g water.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the insides of the cabbage kimchi.
2. Chop the kimchi from step 1 and squeeze out the moisture.
3. Finely chop the carrots, onions, and green onions.
4. Sift the egg whites and yolks.
5. Add half a cup of water to the egg, stir well, mix ingredients 1 and 2 with cold rice, and season with salted shrimp.
6. Put 5 in a steamer and steam it.

739.ingredients_en: 60g cockles (20g cockle meat), 40g tteokbokki rice cake, 8g red pepper paste, 10g onion, 5g green onion, 3g grain syrup, 3g brown rice oil, 2.5g minced garlic, 1g soy sauce, 1g red pepper powder, 1g sesame oil, 0.5g sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the tteokbokki rice cakes in half and blanch them in boiling water.
2. Wash the cockles and boil them lightly in boiling water (residual heat) in which the rice cakes were blanched. Once cooled, remove the cockles.
3. Place the blanched rice cake and cockle meat on skewers alternately.
4. Chop green onions and onions.
5. Make red pepper paste seasoning by adding red pepper paste, onion, green onion, minced garlic, grain syrup, soy sauce, red pepper powder, and sesame oil.
6. Put a little brown rice oil in a pan and stir-fry the red pepper paste seasoning. Coat the cockle rice cake skewers in step 3 with the red pepper paste seasoning and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

743.name_en: Maesaengi Seaweed Soup with Small Rice Cakes
743.ingredients_en: 140g clam cake, 15g maesaengi, 30g oyster, 5g green onion, 2g minced garlic, 3g dried anchovy, 1g soup soy sauce, 0.2g salt, 300g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Boil 1 and a half cups of water and dried anchovies in a pot to obtain 1 cup of anchovy broth.
2. Rinse the maesaengi three or four times with water and place in a fine sieve to remove moisture.
3. Add salt to the oysters, knead them gently to avoid crushing them, then rinse them with water three or four times and place them in a sieve.
4. Slice the green onion thinly diagonally and mince the garlic.
5. Add clam rice cake, maesaengi, and oysters to the anchovy broth and boil.
6. Add green onions and minced garlic and boil for a while. Finish by seasoning with soy sauce and salt.

745.ingredients_en: 60g gwamegi, 15g pickled plum, 5g onion, 1g minced ginger, 1g garlic, 10g red pepper paste, 5g onion, 3g minced garlic, 3g minced green onion, 2g soy sauce, 2g plum juice, 1g red pepper powder, 15g water, 0.1g sesame seeds, 0.1g pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut off the tail of gwamegi.
2. Take out the minced ginger and garlic juice and sprinkle it on the prepared gwamegi.
3. Make seasoning sauce by mixing red pepper paste, minced garlic, chopped green onion, plum juice, red pepper powder, pepper powder, and water.
4. Slice the pickled plum.
5. Place the gwamegi in a pan, apply red pepper paste seasoning, and lightly fry.
6. Finish by placing the pickled plum on top of the grilled gwamegi.

748.ingredients_en: Rice 180, cabbage kimchi (stem part) 30, onion 20, fresh shiitake mushroom 40, cherry tomato 200, olive oil 12, soy sauce 4, pizza cheese (mozzarella) 30, chopped green onion 5

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop kimchi, onions, and mushrooms.
2. Cut the cherry tomatoes into four pieces.
3. Put olive oil in a pan and fry kimchi, onions, mushrooms, and tomatoes.
4. Add rice, stir-fry, and season with soy sauce.
5. Place items 3 and 4 in a bowl, top with pizza cheese, and cook in the microwave until the cheese melts.
6. Finish by sprinkling green onions.

749.ingredients_en: Oysters 50, scorched rice 50, kelp broth (dried kelp 2, water 450), chives 10, soy sauce 3, sesame oil 2, green seaweed 0.5

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the oysters by shaking them in salt water and chop them coarsely.
2. Wash the chives and chop them into small pieces.
3. Add kelp broth to the scorched rice, soak for 2 minutes, and then boil.
4. When the scorched rice has almost spread, add the oysters and boil briefly.
5. When the porridge spreads, add chives and boil for a while.
6. Place in a bowl and top with crumbled roasted green seaweed.

750.ingredients_en: Balls: 50 bean curd, 25 minced pork (without fat), 5 radish radish, 2.5 salted shrimp, 5 eggs, 10 potato starch, 0.02 pepper, 4 minced green onions, 2 minced garlic. Soup: anchovy kelp broth (300 water, 2.5 dried anchovies, 2 dried kelp), 20 bok choy, 5 diagonally sliced green onions, minced. 1 garlic, 5 soy sauce

steps_en.instruction: 1. Place the soybean curd in a sieve to remove moisture.
2. Finely chop the radish radish and salted shrimp.
3. Add minced pork, radish radish, salted shrimp, egg, starch, pepper, green onion, and garlic to step 1 and knead.
4. Form the kneaded dough into bite-sized round balls.
5. Put the anchovy kelp broth in a pot and when it boils, add the meatballs and boil while skimming off the foam.
6. When the meatballs are cooked and float, add bok choy, green onions, and garlic, boil briefly, season with soy sauce, and remove from heat.

751.name_en: Grilled pork ribs and braised white kimchi and wine
751.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 200 pork back ribs (70 ribs), 500 water, 2 soybean paste, 10 green onions, 3 ginger, 4 olive oil, 0.02 pepper, 0.38 salt Kimchi stew: 60 white kimchi, 40 red wine, 15 cooking wine, 3 honey

steps_en.instruction: 1. Put water in a pot, dissolve soybean paste, add green onion and ginger, and boil.
2. When the water boils, add the pork ribs and boil for 5 minutes.
3. Cut the white kimchi into 5cm long pieces.
4. Put red wine in a pot and put it on fire to evaporate the alcohol, then add kimchi, cooking wine, and honey and simmer until the flavor is absorbed.
5. Sprinkle salt on the boiled back ribs, apply olive oil and fry in a pan.
6. Serve grilled ribs with braised white kimchi and wine.

753.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 50 kodari, 7.5 scorched rice powder, 4 soybean oil, 2 chopped red peppers, 2 chopped green onions Seasoning sauce: 3 soy sauce, 1.5 sugar, 1.25 cooking wine, 1 fine red pepper powder, 5 minced onions, 1 minced garlic

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the belly of the nose bridge into two lengthwise pieces and remove the bones.
2. Cut the trimmed nose bridge in half and spread scorched rice powder on the inside.
3. Mix the ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
4. Put oil in a pan and fry the kodari.
5. Apply seasoning sauce to the nose bridge and lightly grill again.
6. Finish by sprinkling chopped red pepper and green onion.

754.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 60 cod meat, 0.3 salt, 0.02 white pepper, 12 glutinous rice powder, 40 king oyster mushrooms, 2 garlic, 6 olive oil, 5 baby vegetables Sauce: 4 mayonnaise, 1 minced wasabi, 2 lemon juice, 0.02 pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Season the cod meat with salt and white pepper, then lightly coat it with glutinous rice powder. (a)
2. Slice the mushrooms and garlic into thin slices. (b)
3. Put oil in a pan and fry the garlic until fragrant. Set aside the garlic and fry the mushrooms. (c)
4. Add oil to the pan and fry 1 until golden brown on both sides. (d)
5. Mix the ingredients to make the sauce.
6. Arrange cod, mushrooms, and garlic on a plate, drizzle with sauce, and serve with baby vegetables.

755.ingredients_en: 10 peanuts, 10 small anchovies, 2.5 cooking wine, 2 olive oil, 1 dried red pepper, 1 sesame oil, 1 soybean oil, 1 minced garlic, 0.3 oyster sauce, 1 soybean paste, 6 starch syrup, 0.5 sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Put the anchovies in a dry pan and stir-fry.
2. Add olive oil and cooking wine to the lightly stir-fried anchovies and fry until soft.
3. Soak the peanuts in cold water for 20 minutes and drain through a sieve.
4. Chop the dried red pepper into small pieces.
5. Mix olive oil, sesame oil, and soybean oil in a pan, add minced garlic to fragrant, then stir-fry peanuts and red pepper.
6. Add stir-fried anchovies, oyster sauce, bean paste sauce, and starch syrup, mix thoroughly, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

756.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: Spinach (Pohang vinegar) 30, red onion 10, beet 10 Dressing: balsamic vinegar 5, oligosaccharide 3, olive oil 1, salt 0.38

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the Pohang vinegar thoroughly and remove the leaves.
2. Slice the red onion thinly.
3. Cut the beets into strips and soak them in cold water.
4. Mix the ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
5. Remove moisture from the pohang vinegar, red onion, and beets.
6. Mix the drained pohang vinegar, red onion, and beets with the sauce.

757.ingredients_en: Soaked seaweed (or water seaweed) 7, seaweed (raw) 10, seaweed 1.3, onion 7, citron syrup 15, water 20, chopped green onion 4, minced garlic 1, potato starch 10, egg 7, soybean oil 4

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the seaweed and seaweed, squeeze out the water, and finely chop. Lightly toast the seaweed and break it up.
2. Finely chop the onion and citron syrup.
3. Combine steps 1 and 2, add potato starch and eggs and knead.
4. Form the dough into a round ball and fry it in oil.
5. Mix the Yujacheong broth with water, put it in a pan, and boil until thick to make the sauce.
6. Serve fried seaweed with sauce.

759.ingredients_en: Walnuts 15, olive oil 4, tteokbokki rice cakes 80, oligosaccharides 20, soy sauce 1.5, black sesame seeds (roasted) 0.5

steps_en.instruction: 1. Coarsely chop the walnuts.
2. Lightly fry the chopped walnuts in a dry pan.
3. Add oil to the pan and fry the rice cake until it becomes soft.
4. When the rice cake is cooked, add oligosaccharide and soy sauce and stir-fry briefly.
5. Add walnuts and fry a little more to combine the flavors.
6. Finish by sprinkling black sesame seeds.

760.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 90 rice, 30 bean sprouts, 40 boiled bamboo shoots, 90 green tea water Seasoning sauce: 4 soy sauce, 0.5 red pepper powder, 1 sugar, 0.5 sesame salt, 2.5 minced green onions, 1.25 minced garlic, 2.5 Cheongyang peppers, 1.25 red peppers, 3.75 cooking wine, 1 sesame oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the bean sprouts thoroughly and remove the tails.
2. Cut the bamboo shoots thinly into bite-sized pieces using the comb pattern.
3. Mix all the seasoning ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
4. Put washed rice in a pot, add bean sprouts and bamboo shoots, and pour green tea-infused water to cook the rice.
5. When the rice is done, let it steam.
6. Boil the rice, add the seasoning sauce, and eat.

761.ingredients_en: Bibimbap: 210 rice, 50 sea squirt meat, 10 chives, 5 radish sprouts, 0.5 seaweed, 4 sesame oil, 1.5 sesame seeds. Seasoning: 5 red pepper paste, 1 sugar, 3 lemon juice, 3 minced onions, 3 plum juice.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the stem of the sea squirt, peel it, and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
2. Cut the chives into 2cm long pieces.
3. Thinly slice the seaweed into the same length as the chives.
4. Mix all the seasoning ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
5. Add sesame oil to the cleaned sea squirt and mix lightly.
6. Put rice in a bowl, add chives, radish sprouts, sea squirts, seaweed, and sesame seeds, mix with seasoning sauce, and eat.

763.ingredients_en: 50 flounder, 15 clams, 20 mugwort, 200 water, 9 soybean paste, 4 green onions, 6 perilla seed powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the scales, intestines, and fins of the flounder and cut into three pieces.
2. Dissolve soybean paste in water and boil.
3. Add flounder and clams and boil for another 20 minutes.
4. Add mugwort and boil for 5 minutes.
5. Add green onion and perilla seed powder and boil briefly.
6. Put flounder and mugwort in a bowl first, then pour the soup on the side and serve.

764.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: Beef sirloin 60, chives 5, olive oil 5 Seasoning sauce: soy sauce 4, sugar 3, minced onion 15, minced garlic 2, pepper 0.01

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the wild chives into 3cm long pieces.
2. Mix all the seasoning ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
3. Add chives and seasoning sauce to the beef and mix well until seasoned.
4. Take the seasoned meat one by one and shape it into a greased pan.
5. Cook the lumped meat evenly on both sides.
6. Place in a bowl and finish.

765.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 50g duck meat, 20g bear skin, 10g radish sprouts, 4 olive oil Sauce: 1g Schisandra chinensis extract, 6g red pepper paste, 2g sugar, 2.5g vinegar, 2.5g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Blanch the bear skin and rinse in cold water.
2. Cut the rinsed bear skin into 10cm lengths.
3. Mix Schisandra chinensis extract, red pepper paste, sugar, vinegar, and water to make Schisandra chinensis red pepper paste sauce.
4. Cook the duck in a pan.
5. Place roast duck and radish sprouts on the pork skin, spread Schisandra chinensis red pepper paste, and roll it up.
6. Place in a bowl and finish.

766.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 50 flour, 25 water, 100 clams (50 clam meat), 20 onions, 5 garlic, 5 Cheongyang peppers, 5 green onions, 4 soybean oil, 5 cooking wine, 2 sesame oil Seasoning sauce: 25 water, 1.5 oyster sauce, 1 soy sauce, 1.5 plum juice, 1 fish sauce

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add water to flour and make sujebi dough.
2. Cook the dough in boiling water and place it in a strainer.
3. Thinly slice the onion, slice the garlic, slice the Cheongyang pepper diagonally, and finely chop the green onion.
4. Mix the ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
5. Put oil in a pan and stir-fry garlic. Add clams and cooking wine and stir-fry.
6. Stir-fry onion and Cheongyang pepper, then add seasoning sauce, sujebi, and sesame oil and lightly fry.

767.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: Dandelion 15, Onion 10 Seasoning: Red pepper powder 1.25, Sesame salt 1, Salt 0.25, Minced green onion 1.25, Minced garlic 0.5, Plum juice 4.5

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash dandelions under running water.
2. Tear the cleanly washed dandelions into bite-sized pieces and gently remove the moisture.
3. Slice the onion thinly.
4. Mix all the seasoning ingredients to make the seasoning sauce.
5. Put the onion and dandelion in a bowl, add the seasoning and lightly season.
6. Finish by putting it in a bowl.

768.ingredients_en: 70g tuna, 1.5g soy sauce, 0.5g salt, 2.25g minced green onion, 1g minced garlic, 3g perilla oil, 6g perilla seed powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Briefly blanch the chwinamul in boiling water.
2. Rinse the blanched chwinamul in cold water.
3. Lightly squeeze the chwinamul to remove any moisture and cut it into 5cm long pieces.
4. Prepare the seasoning sauce by mixing all the remaining ingredients.
5. Put the chives in a bowl, add the seasoning sauce, and mix well.
6. Finish by placing the seasoned vegetables in a bowl.

770.ingredients_en: Main ingredients: 20 green garlic, 200 water, 5 dried squid Seasoning: 1.25 flour, 20 water, 0.25 salt, 0.6 red pepper powder, 0.75 salted shrimp, 0.2g anchovy sauce, 1 sugar, 0.5 sesame seeds, 0.25 ginger juice

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the green garlic thoroughly and cut it into 5cm long pieces.
2. Soak the green garlic in water for about 30 minutes to remove the pungency.
3. Cut the squid into 1cm x 5cm pieces.
4. Mix flour and water, stir over low heat and cool.
5. Add all remaining seasoning ingredients to the paste and mix.
6. Mix the green garlic and squid with the seasoning sauce and eat right away or lightly cooked.

777.ingredients_en:
●Main ingredients: 30g (1/3) yam, 20g (10) jujubes, 35g (25) ginkgo nuts, 40g (1/8) sweet pumpkin, 15g (1/3) asparagus, 20g (1) young corn, 10g (2) garlic, 200g (1 piece) rice.
●Broth: 550g (1 chicken), 15g (1 tablespoon) green onion, 15 (3) garlic

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the chicken flesh.
2. Add green onions and garlic to the remaining bones and make broth.
3. Cut the yam and sweet pumpkin into 1x1x5cm pieces.
4. Roast garlic, asparagus, and young corn.
5. Add yams, jujubes, rice, sweet pumpkin, and ginkgo nuts to the chicken and wrap.
6. Steam the sweet pumpkin to be served in a steamer.

782.ingredients_en: 20g sweet potato, 15g button mushroom, 10g onion, 7g oyster mushroom, 30g brown rice (soaked), 130g low-fat milk, 20g cooking oil, 100g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the sweet potato, dice it into 1cm pieces, and boil it.
2. Coarsely chop the button mushrooms and onions and blanch the oyster mushrooms.
3. Add cooking oil to a pot and fry the onions, sweet potatoes, and button mushrooms in that order.
4. Add 1/2 cup of brown rice and 1/2 cup of water and grind coarsely in a mixer.
5. Add 4 and the remaining milk to 3 and boil.
6. Place 5 in a bowl and place sweet potatoes and blanched oyster mushrooms in the center.

784.ingredients_en: 150g rice, 70g tofu, 10g shiitake mushrooms (dried), 5g carrots, 5g potatoes, 5g green bell peppers, 5g red bell peppers, 10g cucumbers, 10g zucchini, 0.2g salt [Introduction of sauce] 2g soy sauce, 0.5g green peppers, 0.5g red peppers, 0.2g sesame seeds, sesame oil 2g, 5g kelp water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Mash the tofu and squeeze out the moisture using a small spear.
2. Spread it flat in a frying pan and fry until golden brown.
3. Roughly break up the baked tofu and stir-fry with soy sauce.
4. Cut carrots, potatoes, bell peppers, zucchini, soaked shiitake mushrooms, and cucumbers into small cubes and fry them with salt.
5. Add potatoes, shiitake mushrooms, tofu, and rice to the pan and stir-fry, then add the remaining vegetables and stir-fry.
6. Make the seasoning sauce and serve together.

787.name_en: Seaweed Soup with Small Rice Cakes
787.ingredients_en: 5g dried seaweed, 20g burdock, 100g dried rice cake, 18g perilla seeds, 4g perilla oil, 4g garlic, 300g water, 4g soup soy sauce

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the dried seaweed in water and cut it into bite-size pieces.
2. Sharpen the burdock with a pencil and wash it by massaging it in cold water several times to remove the bitter taste.
3. Add water to the blender and finely grind the perilla seeds.
4. Put perilla oil in a pot, add burdock and stir-fry gently, then add seaweed and stir-fry together.
5. Add perilla seed water to step 4 and boil until the seaweed becomes soft.
6. When the perilla and seaweed soup becomes soft, add the clam rice cake and minced garlic and boil the rice cake soup.

789.ingredients_en: 20g pine nuts, 20g sesame seeds, 10g cucumber, 70g flour, 0.2g salt, 10g cherry tomatoes, 0.5g black sesame seeds, 300g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the seaweed and soak it in enough water. Slice the cucumber finely.
2. Put the seaweed in a pot, pour in a small amount of water, and once it boils, turn off the heat and rinse the boiled seaweed in cold water and peel it.
3. Put seoritae and pine nuts in a mixer, add water, and grind until fine.
4. Add a small amount of salt to the flour and knead.
5. Cut the dough into thin noodles and boil them in boiling water.
6. Put the noodles in a bowl, pour in the pine nuts and bean water, top with sliced ​​cucumbers and halved cherry tomatoes, and sprinkle with black sesame seeds to finish.

791.ingredients_en:
140g rice, 15g minced beef, 0.01g pepper powder, 2g sesame oil, 20g Swiss chard, 15g kelp, 20g cabbage, 20g kale, 20g endive, 10g perilla leaves, 1g water parsley, 10g squid [Source introduction] Low-sodium seasoned soy sauce: 6g soy sauce, water 30g, 3g red pepper, 2g green gochujang
Low sodium super red pepper paste: 1g red pepper paste, 0.5g vinegar, 0.5g sugar, 0.5g cider

steps_en.instruction: 1. Mix sesame oil with well-cooked rice, season minced beef with pepper and sesame oil, stir-fry, and mix with rice to make rice balls.
2. Blanch the Swiss chard and season with salt, minced garlic, and sesame oil.
3. Rinse the ssam kelp in water, then blanch it in boiling water and cut it into 6cm wide pieces.
4. Wash and drain the kale and endive, and marinate the perilla leaves in low-sodium seasoned soy sauce.
5. Clean the water parsley and squid, lightly blanch them, and cut the squid into thin slices.
6. Roll the rice ball in step 1 with each of the prepared ingredients and finish with ssamjang and low-sodium red pepper paste.

792.ingredients_en: 30g rice, 30g brown rice, 30g shiitake mushrooms, 30g carrots, 7.5g jujubes, 3g ginkgo nuts, 12g chestnuts, 20g kelp broth [Source introduction] Low-sodium soy sauce: 1g soy sauce, 4g apple juice, 0.5g mustard, 3g sesame oil, 1g sesame salt, 1g green pepper, 1g red pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash and soak rice and brown glutinous rice.
2. Cut shiitake mushrooms and carrots into bank-sized pieces.
3. Peel the jujubes and cut them into bank-sized pieces.
4. Mix shiitake mushrooms, carrots, jujubes, ginkgo nuts, and chestnuts in step 1 and place in a pot.
5. Cook rice with less kelp broth than usual.
6. When the rice is cooked, serve it with soy sauce seasoning.

793.ingredients_en: 40g red beans, 30g glutinous rice powder, 10g glutinous rice, 300g water, sugar according to preference

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash and soak the glutinous rice.
2. Wash and remove the red beans, then pour enough water to cover them and boil.
3. When the dark red water comes out, remove it, add 3 times the amount of water as the red beans, and boil until completely mushy.
4. Knead the glutinous rice powder with boiling water and make glutinous rice dumplings about 1.5cm long.

5. After kneading the boiled red beans with your hands, strain them through a sieve to allow the sediment to settle. When the water boils first, add the soaked glutinous rice and boil until it spreads.
6. Add bean paste and glutinous rice dumplings one by one and boil. When the dumplings float, boil for another 2 to 3 minutes and finish. (Use sugar or honey according to preference.)

794.ingredients_en: 50g zucchini, 10g shiitake mushrooms, 5g green pepper, 0.1g salt, 10g spinach, 2g sesame oil, 0.4g sesame seeds, 2g cooking oil, 0.2g pepper powder, 40g flour, 20g water [Introduction of sauce] Soy sauce: 2g soy sauce, 5g vinegar, 5g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the pumpkin and chop it coarsely, sprinkle with salt, remove the moisture, fry thoroughly over high heat and cool.
2. Soak the shiitake mushrooms, remove the stalks, scoop out the thick ones, slice them, season with perilla oil, and fry over high heat. Chop the green peppers and fry briefly.
3. When the roasted pumpkin, peppers, and mushrooms are completely cooled, mix them and season with sesame seeds, pepper powder, and sesame oil.
4. Mix the amount of flour and water to make the dough, then roll it out to a thickness of 0.2cm and stamp it using a round mold with a diameter of about 7~8cm to make the dumpling skin.
5. Make dumplings by adding dumpling filling to the dumpling skin.
6. Place wet small intestines in a steaming steamer and steam them with dumplings, or boil them in boiling water with a little salt so that they do not burst.

804.ingredients_en: 20g dried shiitake mushrooms, 20g lotus root, 20g orange paprika, 20g yellow paprika, 20g broccoli, 10g cooking oil [Sauce introduction] Sweet and sour sauce: 7g potato starch powder, 5g red wine, 2g soy sauce, 1g vinegar, 1g sugar

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the shiitake mushrooms, remove the stems, boil in boiling water, and then remove the moisture.
2. Season the cleaned shiitake mushrooms with soy sauce, minced garlic, and sesame oil.
3. Peel the lotus root, dice it and soak it in vinegar water.
4. Cut the paprika into diamond shapes and cut the broccoli into bite-sized bunches.
5. Coat the prepared ingredients sufficiently with starch powder and fry them in cooking oil at about 170℃.
6. Add red wine, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar and boil for about 20 minutes. Adjust the consistency with water starch mixed with starch and water and pour into step 4.

805.ingredients_en: 100g rice, 20g various sprouts, 2g radish sprouts, 5g celery, 5g crown crown, 15g radish [Source introduction] Low-sodium stir-fried red pepper paste (5 servings): 7.5g red pepper paste, 15g water, 50g apple, 2.5g sugar, 2g sesame oil, 20g minced beef Meat seasoning (5 servings): 2.5g minced green onion, 1.3g minced garlic, 1.3g sesame salt, 2g sesame oil, 2g pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash sprouts and radish sprouts and remove moisture.
2. Peel the celery and cut it diagonally into 3cm pieces.
3. Cut the crown crown into 3cm pieces and shred the radish.
4. Season the minced beef.
5. Add a small amount of cooking oil to a pan and stir-fry the seasoned beef, then add the sauce ingredients and stir-fry to make low-sodium stir-fried red pepper paste.
6. Put the rice in a bowl, add the prepared sprouts and vegetables, and add low-sodium stir-fried red pepper paste.

807.ingredients_en: 70g eggplant, 0.5g ginger, 2g red pepper paste, 2g starch syrup, 0.5g sesame seeds, 2g perilla oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the eggplants thoroughly and cut them into 1x1x4cm pieces.
2. Finely chop the ginger.
3. Make seasoning sauce by mixing red pepper paste, starch syrup, and sesame seeds.
4. Add perilla oil to the pan and fry the eggplants over high heat.
5. When the eggplants are all fried, add the seasoning sauce and stir-fry just enough to mix the seasoning sauce.
6. Place on a plate.

809.ingredients_en: 30g pork, 30g green bell pepper, 6g canned bamboo shoots, 1.4g red pepper, 7g shiitake mushrooms, 0.4g salt, 1g sesame oil, 5g cooking oil [Source introduction] Seasoning for meat: 0.1g pepper powder, 1g rice wine, 4g egg, 3g starch powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the pepper in half and remove the inside.
2. Cut the cleaned pepper into 3cm long pieces.
3. Slice bamboo shoots, shiitake mushrooms, green onions, and ginger.
4. Slice the pork thinly, then finely slice it into 0.3x5cm pieces and season.
5. Cover the seasoned pork with egg white and starch powder.
6. Put cooking oil in a pan, stir-fry ginger until fragrant, add vegetables and meat, stir-fry, season, then add sesame oil and bake.

810.ingredients_en: 50g cabbage leaves, 30g radish, 10g carrots, 5g green onions, 10g fresh ginseng, 3g garlic, 5g ginger, 2.5g red pepper powder, 10g water parsley, 2g red pepper, 70g water, 0.5g salt.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut cabbage and radish into 2x2cm pieces.
2. Lightly pickle the sliced ​​cabbage and radish with salt.
3. Cut the carrots into shapes and cut the green onions and water parsley into 2cm pieces.
4. Chop the garlic, ginger, and red pepper and cut the fresh ginseng diagonally.
5. Boil water, let it cool, and make kimchi soup by wrapping red pepper powder in small intestines.
6. Radish and cabbage are pickled and kimchi broth is poured over the prepared ingredients to complete the dish.

811.ingredients_en: 20g glass noodles, 5g shiitake mushrooms, 5g cabbage, 5g cucumber, 3g carrots, 5g perilla leaves, 5g lettuce, 3g green bell pepper, 3g red bell pepper, 3g enoki mushrooms, 3g yellow paprika, 2g soy sauce, 3g perilla oil [Source introduction] Japchae seasoning: 10g pear, 2g soy sauce, salt 0.1g, 1g mustard, 2g vinegar, 1g sugar, 1g olive oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the glass noodles in water and boil them in boiling water until they become soft. Rinse them in cold water and drain them.
2. Soak the shiitake mushrooms, squeeze and slice them.
3. Season the Pyo-gyo mushrooms with soy sauce and perilla oil and fry them in a pan.
4. Finely chop cabbage, cucumber, carrot, perilla leaves, lettuce, green pepper, and paprika.
5. Grate the pears and add soy sauce, salt, vinegar, mustard, and sugar to make japchae seasoning.
6. Arrange the prepared vegetables neatly on a large plate, place the glass noodles in the center, and pour the seasoning.

812.ingredients_en: 14g sweet pumpkin, 14g tofu, 1.4g garlic, 10.5g green pepper [Sauce introduction] Low-sodium simmering sauce: 2.4g soy sauce, 1.1g rice wine, 12.3g dashi water, 0.4g cooking wine, 0.4g sugar, 0.1g salt, 0.7 g cooking oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the sweet pumpkin thoroughly, cut it in half, remove the seeds, and steam it in a steamer.
2. Remove the skin from the cooled pumpkin and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
3. Cut the tofu into 1.5cm cubes and boil.
4. Chop the garlic into small pieces and slice the green pepper into small pieces and fry them in a pan.
5. Mix the ingredients together with soy sauce, boil briefly and cool.
6. Add the prepared ingredients and sprinkle with the sauce.

816.ingredients_en: 5g shiitake mushrooms, 10g button mushrooms, 10g oyster mushrooms, 5g enoki mushrooms, 10g king oyster mushrooms, 2g cooking oil [Source introduction] Oyster sauce: 0.3g oyster sauce, 0.3g soy sauce, 1g minced garlic, 5g water, 0.6g sesame oil, 10g chives or green onions

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the mushrooms well and take them out.
2. Add cooking oil to the pan, add mushrooms, and heat in a 175℃ oven for 5 minutes.
3. Mix all the sauce seasonings and boil.
4. Sprinkle the sauce from step 3 on the oven-baked mushrooms.
5. Cut the chives to similar size to the mushrooms.
6. Garnish with sliced ​​chives or green onions.

820.ingredients_en: 2g hoisin sauce, 1.3g soy sauce, 5g starch, 2.5g sesame oil, 5g cooking oil, 2.5g minced garlic, 90g tofu 1.2cm, 10g green beans, 20g bok choy, 15g young corn, 20g chestnuts, 10g chopped peanuts, 20g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add water, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, starch, sesame oil, and starch powder to a small fire and mix until the starch powder is well dissolved.
2. Place a large saucepan over medium heat. Add cooking oil and fry the garlic for 15 to 20 seconds without burning.
3. Add tofu and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until light golden brown.
4. Add the blanched green beans, bok choy, young corn, and chestnuts and mix.
5. Pour sauce on the stir-fried tofu.
6. Finish by sprinkling peanut powder.

822.ingredients_en: 60g of simple cabbage, 0.6g of red pepper [Source introduction low sodium seasoning: 30g of tofu, 3.5g of soybean paste, 1.5g of garlic, 2g of sesame seeds, 1g of sesame oil, 20g of apple, 5g of red pepper, 15g of water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the cabbage.
2. Blanch the washed cabbage in boiling water.
3. Remove the seeds from the red pepper and slice it diagonally.
4. Wash the blanched cabbage in cold water and squeeze thoroughly.
5. Put the low-sodium marinade seasoning ingredients into a mixer.
6. Add the shredded pepper and marinated seasoning to step 4 and mix.

825.ingredients_en: 20g glass noodles, 20g thinly sliced sirloin, 5g carrots, 10g dried shiitake mushrooms, 10g oyster mushrooms, 10g onions, 5g chives, 10g bellflower root, 5g eggs, 2g soy sauce, 5g sugar, 1g garlic, 10g green onions, 0.1g pepper powder, 1g sesame salt, sesame oil 2g, cooking oil 1g [Sauce introduction] Low-sodium soy sauce: 1g soy sauce, 2g water, 1g sugar, 1g vinegar

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the glass noodles in water and boil them in boiling water until they become soft. Rinse them in cold water and drain them.
2. Soak the shiitake mushrooms, squeeze them, cut into strips, season with soy sauce and perilla oil, and fry in a pan.
3. Finely chop cabbage, cucumber, carrot, perilla leaves, lettuce, green pepper, and paprika.
4. Grate the pears.
5. Make japchae seasoning by adding pear, soy sauce, salt, vinegar, mustard, and sugar.
6. Arrange the prepared vegetables neatly on a large plate, place the glass noodles in the center, and pour the seasoning.

827.ingredients_en: 10g green pepper, 10g perilla leaf, 20g zucchini, 5g red pepper, 50g flour, 3g red pepper, 5g cooking oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop the zucchini.
2. Slice the perilla leaves and chop them coarsely.
3. Cut the green pepper and red pepper in half and slice thinly.
4. Add water to the flour, knead until smooth, and then dissolve the red pepper paste.
5. Mix the vegetables into the dough and fry the rice cakes in a lightly oiled pan.
6. Garnish the rice cake with sliced ​​green and red peppers.

832.ingredients_en: 10g konjac, 20g seaweed, 2g garlic, 5g garlic sprouts, 5g paprika [Sauce introduction] Low-sodium stewing sauce: 3.4g soy sauce, 2.2g sugar, 20g water, 1.5g rice wine, 0.1g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak soybeans in water for more than 6 hours.
2. Boil the soaked tub for 20 to 25 minutes and remove the skin.
3. Add sesame seeds and water to the boiled beans with the skin removed, grind them finely, and place them in a sieve.
4. Thickly chop the acorn jelly into 7cm long pieces.
5. Slice the cucumber diagonally.
6. Put the jelly in a bowl, pour the prepared soybean soup and garnish with cucumber slices.

836.ingredients_en: 70g tofu, 10g starch powder, 10g cooking oil, 5g green bell pepper, 5g red bell pepper, 5g yellow paprika, 2g soy sauce, 5g starch syrup, 1g red pepper paste, 2g sesame oil, 0.5g sesame seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the tofu into cubes, sprinkle with salt, remove moisture, and cover with starch powder.
2. Fry the tofu in cooking oil at 175℃ twice until crispy.
3. Cut the green pepper and paprika into 0.5cm squares.
4. Mix soy sauce, starch syrup, red pepper paste, and water in proportions on the fire.
5. Stir-fry green peppers and paprika in a pan with cooking oil, then add the mixed braised sauce and boil.
6. When the braised sauce in step 5 has thickened, add the fried tofu, mix carefully, and finish with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

853.ingredients_en:
38g beef sirloin, 12g pear, 9g cucumber, 0.5g pine nut powder, 0.5g cooking oil [Sauce introduction] Meat marinade: 2.5g wine, 0.1g pepper powder
Low-sodium soy sauce: 1.3g soy sauce, 3.8g apple juice, 1.3g vinegar, 1.3g sugar, wasami 0.8g

steps_en.instruction: 1. Trim the beef sirloin, pound it gently with the back of a knife, cut it into 4cm long pieces, and marinate it in a marinade for about 30 minutes.
2. Cut the cucumber into 0.2cm-thick rounds, lightly pickle in salt and squeeze.
3. Remove the peel and seeds from the pear and cut into half-moon shapes 0.2cm thick.
4. Put cooking oil in a pan and lightly fry the cucumbers over high heat until the pears turn golden brown.
5. Fry the marinated beef sirloin in a pan and make vinegared soy sauce.
6. Top the golden brown belly with beef sirloin, top it with cucumber and pine nut powder, lightly wrap it, and dip it in low-sodium vinegared soy sauce.

857.ingredients_en: 80g raw potatoes, 50g minced beef, 50g broth, 3g starch powder [Source introduction] Beef seasoning: 1g chopped green onion, 1g minced garlic, 1g minced green pepper, 1g minced red pepper, 1.2g soy sauce, 1.2g sugar, 0.5g sesame salt, 1g sesame oil, pepper powder 0.1g, water parsley leaf decoration

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the potatoes, cut them in half, and trim the bottom so that they can lie comfortably.
2. Use a spoon to scoop out the top of the potato.
3. Add the ingredients to the minced beef and season.
4. Coat the dug out potatoes with starch and fill them with seasoned beef.
5. Pour broth enough to cover the potatoes and boil.
6. Once steamed, pour starch water to thicken.

859.name_en: Grilled sirloin with button mushrooms and grape juice
