859.ingredients_en: 50g beef sirloin, 20g button mushrooms, 50g grape juice, 80g tomatoes, 15g water, 2.5g basil, 1.3g sugar, 2g oregano, 0.5g garlic powder, 0.4g salt, 5g chopped parsley, 0.2g bay leaves, 2.5g rosemary, 1g peppercorns, 2.5g thyme

steps_en.instruction: 1. Put the meat in a glass bowl, add rosemary, crushed peppercorns, sliced ​​button mushrooms, bay leaves, and grape juice and marinate.
2. Mix tomato sauce, beef broth, basil, oregano, sugar, and garlic powder in a small glass bowl.
3. Take out the marinated meat and cook the front and back in a heated pan.
4. Pour the remaining broth from step 1 and the tomato sauce from step 2 into the pan where the meat was cooked.
5. Scrape the pieces of meat stuck to the pan and boil them together over medium heat to make button mushroom sauce.
6. Slice the steak, place it in a bowl, and top with the button mushroom sauce.

868.ingredients_en: 40g beef, 16g fresh shiitake mushrooms, 9g button mushrooms, 12g oyster mushrooms, 0.4g white tree ear mushrooms, 0.4g wood ear mushrooms, 4g celery, 8g red bell peppers, 2g sake, 2g soy sauce, 10g broth, 0.2g pepper powder, 1g sesame oil, 9g cooking oil [Sauce introduction] Beef seasoning: 2g starch, 2g egg

steps_en.instruction: 1. Thinly slice the beef.
2. Add starch and eggs to the shredded beef and season.
3. Wash mushrooms and vegetables and cut them into 0.3cm thick pieces.
4. Add beef to the frying pan and stir-fry.
5. Add vegetables and mushrooms and fry once more.
6. Add soy sauce, sake, and pepper powder to the broth, boil, and add sesame oil at the end.

869.ingredients_en: 20g octopus, 20g octopus, 80g raw noodles, 20g cabbage, 13g onion, 13g oyster mushroom, 13g shiitake mushroom [Sauce introduction] Stir-fry sauce: 8g green bell pepper, 5g red bell pepper, 15g Cheongyang pepper, 13g green onion, 1g oyster sauce, 2g red pepper powder, 2g spicy red pepper powder, 0.2g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the octopus and octopus in salt water and clean them.
2. Cut the octopus into 5cm lengths.
3. Slice the vegetables thinly into 10cm pieces each.
4. Make the sauce.
5. Blanch the raw noodles in boiling water.
6. Add cooking oil to a heated pan and stir-fry vegetables, then add noodles and sauce and stir-fry thoroughly.

873.ingredients_en: 70g mackerel, 4g flour [Source introduction] Low-sodium balsamic sauce: 1g soy sauce, 13g olive oil, 6g balsamic vinegar, 4g honey

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the prepared mackerel into 5cm long pieces and make a slit in the skin.
2. Coat the cut mackerel with flour.
3. Preheat the oven to 200℃.
4. Complete the sauce by mixing soy sauce, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and honey.
5. Put the mackerel in a pan and bake in the oven.
6. Serve with low-sodium balsamic sauce and grilled mackerel.

874.ingredients_en: 25g of whelk, 13g of onion, 0.8g of green onion, 25g of cucumber, 13g of water parsley, 3g of perilla leaf [Introduction of sauce] Low-sodium red pepper paste sauce: 1g of red pepper powder, 1g of ginger juice, 10g of apple juice, 10g of sugar, 2g of red pepper paste, 3g of vinegar, 1g of sesame salt, 1.3g of sesame oil, 1g minced garlic, 5g green pepper, 5g red pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the onion and green onion into strips and cut the cucumber into half moons.
2. Chop the water parsley and perilla leaves.
3. Remove the water from the whelk and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
4. Soak the green onion slices in ice water.
5. Make low-sodium red pepper paste sauce.
6. Season and complete just before serving.

875.ingredients_en: 20g oysters, 20g tofu, 1g minced garlic, 2g green onions, 0.3g seaweed, 0.5g salted shrimp, 0.2g salt, 1g sesame oil, 100g kelp broth, 1g red pepper.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the oysters thoroughly with salt and drain the water.
2. Cut the tofu into 2x2x1cm pieces and cut the green onions into 2cm long pieces.
3. Roast the seaweed and tear it into small pieces or cut it with scissors.
4. Cut the pepper into strips and remove the seeds.
5. Boil the kelp broth, add tofu and oysters and simmer gently, then add salted shrimp and minced garlic and simmer for a while.
6. Add green onion and red pepper, and finally add seaweed and sesame oil.

876.ingredients_en: 50g Geumtae, 0.1g salt, 0.1g white pepper powder, 3g rice wine, 3g ginger juice, 1g starch powder, 16g bean sprouts, 12g water parsley, 16g oyster mushroom, 0.8g red pepper, 10g carrot, 4g green onion, 16g radish [Source introduction] Steaming sauce: Kelp broth 100g, 2g soy sauce, 2g cooking wine, 1g vinegar

steps_en.instruction: 1. After removing the gills and internal organs of the Geumtae, make a diagonal cut in the body and season with salt, white pepper, rice wine, and ginger juice.
2. Wipe off the moisture from the ground Geumtae and sprinkle it evenly with starch powder.
3. Remove the head and tail of the bean sprouts, cut the water parsley into 7cm long pieces, tear the oyster mushrooms coarsely, and slice the red pepper, green onion, carrot, and radish.
4. Mix kelp broth with soy sauce, cooking wine, and vinegar to make steaming sauce.
5. Place shredded radish and carrots in a steaming bowl, top with starch-coated sea bream and steaming sauce, and steam.
6. Sprinkle sauce occasionally and steam with oyster mushrooms, water parsley, red pepper, bean sprouts, and shredded green onions.

878.ingredients_en: 60g saury, 0.1g pepper powder, 4g flour, 8g starch powder, 2g cooking oil [Source introduction] Low-sodium red pepper paste sauce: 2g tomato ketchup, 2g red pepper paste, 2g garlic, 2.4g ginger juice, 4g chopped green pepper, 2g chopped red pepper, 20g starch syrup, 1g soy sauce, water 75g, 5g cooking wine

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the head and intestines from the saury, clean it, and cut it.
2. Season the cleaned saury with pepper and rice wine.
3. Remove the moisture from the marinated saury and coat it with flour.
4. Cook the flour-covered saury in a pan until golden brown.
5. Add the low-sodium red pepper paste sauce ingredients to the pan and simmer slightly.
6. Sprinkle sauce on the grilled saury.

882.ingredients_en: 100g tofu, 16g conch meat, 16g paeju, salt 0.2 [Source introduction] Garlic olive oil sauce: 0.2g garlic, 7g olive oil, 0.6g chopped basil, 8g cherry tomatoes

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the tofu into 4x1.5x1cm pieces, sprinkle with salt and remove moisture.
2. Remove the intestines from the conch meat and cut it in half. Remove the dirty membrane around the conch meat, clean it and cut it into 2~3 pieces.
3. Chop the basil leaves.
4. Put the minced garlic in a bowl, season with salt, add olive oil little by little, stirring in one direction, then add the chopped basil to make the garlic olive oil sauce.
5. Place the tofu and seafood on skewers one by one and apply the sauce evenly with a brush.
6. Bake until golden brown in a preheated 250℃ oven or grill.

886.name_en: Stewed chive clam meat and bean curd stew
886.ingredients_en: 20g of soybean curd, 20g of clam meat, 5g of chives, 5g of carrots [Sauce introduction] Braised sauce: 1g of soy sauce, 1g of rice wine, 1g of seasoning wine, 1g of sugar, 1g of ginger juice, 0.5g of minced garlic

steps_en.instruction: 1. Rinse clam meat with light salt water and drain.
2. Cut the chives into 2-3cm long pieces and cut the carrots into short strips.
3. Put all the stew ingredients in a pot and when it starts to boil slightly, add the clam meat and lightly blanch it.
4. Add 3 more cups of water to the pot in step 3, add carrots, and simmer until the stew becomes about 2/3 full.
5. In another pan, without oil, add soybean curd and fry until fluffy.
6. Pour all of 4 into 5, add shredded chives and blanched clam meat, and stir-fry until the seasoning is evenly distributed.

889.ingredients_en: 80g squid, 17g carrots, 17g spinach, 19g egg, 7g dried shiitake mushrooms, 1.4g cooking oil, 1.1g flour [Introduction of sauce] Tomato ketchup sauce: 1.1g minced garlic, 1.1g minced onion, 2g tomato ketchup, 60g water, 0.1g pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the squid, cut diagonally inside, and boil.
2. Cut carrots, spinach, and soaked shiitake mushrooms into 0.5cm thick pieces.
3. Blanch spinach in boiling water, rinse in cold water, and drain.
4. Beat the eggs well, make thick egg rolls, and cut them like carrots.
5. Remove the moisture from the squid, sprinkle lightly with flour, add all ingredients 2 and 3, roll it up like rolling kimbap, and secure it in two places with a skewer.
6. Mix the tomato ketchup sauce ingredients and simmer in a pan. Add the squid from step 4, pour over the sauce, simmer, and cut into 1.5cm thick pieces.

890.name_en: Squid Bossam with low-sodium soybean paste sauce
890.ingredients_en: 50g cuttlefish, 9g carrots, 9g cucumber, 7g lettuce [Sauce introduction] Low-sodium soybean paste sauce: 1.6g soybean paste, 1.3g onion, 6.6g water, 0.4g vinegar, 0.2g sugar, 0.2g green pepper, 0.2g red pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the squid in half, remove the skin, and make a diagonal slit inside the body.
2. Blanch the cut squid in boiling water.
3. Cut the poached squid into bite-sized pieces.
4. Turn and peel the cucumber and slice it into 3cm long pieces. Slice the carrots into thin 4cm long pieces.
5. Finely chop the onions and green and red peppers to be used in the dressing and mix with the ingredients to make low-sodium soybean paste sauce.
6. Eat lettuce with squid, cucumber, carrots, and low-sodium soybean paste sauce according to your preference.

909.ingredients_en: 15g sweet potato, 40g rice, 40g water, 8g kimchi, 95g small apple, 1g sesame oil, 1g minced garlic [Sauce 1] 1g soy sauce, 1g soup soy sauce, 1g red pepper powder, 1g minced garlic, 1g sesame seeds, 1.5g chopped green onion, 0.5g sesame oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the sweet potato into 1cm dice.
2. Cut the washed kimchi into small pieces and fry it in a pan with sesame oil. Add garlic and salt and finish with sesame seeds.
3. Add the soaked rice, sweet potatoes, and stir-fried kimchi to the pot and cook until soft.
4. Cut off the top of the apple, scoop out the inside, and fill it with rice.
5. Place apples filled with rice in an oven preheated to 160℃ and bake until the apples are cooked.
6. Mix the seasoning ingredients to make the seasoning sauce and serve with rice.

913.ingredients_en: 15g millet, 10g jujube, 5g peeled chestnuts, 10g glutinous rice powder, 70g water, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash and soak the millet.
2. Put the jujubes and peeled chestnuts in a pot, add 4 cups of water, and boil until the jujubes become soft.
3. Massage the boiled jujube with your hands to release the flesh of the jujube, then strain it through a sieve along with the chestnuts.
4. Pour 5 times more water into the millet and cook while stirring.
5. Add 3 to 4, mix well, then add glutinous rice water and boil until thickened.
6. Season with salt and serve in the prepared bowl.

914.ingredients_en: 30g pork neck, 30g tofu, 50g tomato, 5g minced ginger, 5g chopped green onion, 5g peanut oil, 5g soy sauce, 10g chicken broth, 10g water starch, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Clean the pork and chop it finely.
2. Cut the tofu into 1cm squares.
3. Remove the skin and seeds from the tomatoes and cut them into pieces the same size as the tofu.
4. Stir-fry green onions and ginger in an oiled pan. When fragrant, add 1, stir-fry and set aside.
5. Stir-fry tomatoes, tofu, and meat in an oiled pan, pour in a small amount of broth, and season with soy sauce and salt.
6. When the sauce has reduced, add tofu and add water and starch to adjust the sauce consistency.

918.ingredients_en: 10g chopped carrot, 15g chopped onion, 10g chopped red bell pepper, 10g chopped green bell pepper, 10g chopped ham, 10g rice, 2g curry powder, 30g spring roll skin, 5g cheese, 3g frying oil, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Finely chop the carrots, onions, green bell peppers, red bell peppers, and ham.
2. Add 1 to a heated pan and stir-fry.
3. Add rice to step 2, stir-fry and season with curry powder, salt, and pepper.
4. Cut the cheese into appropriate sizes.
5. Add steps 3 and 4 to the spring roll skin and shape into sticks.
6. Put plenty of oil in the pan and fry 5.

920.ingredients_en: 30g soaked rice, 92g water, 10g tuna meat, 5g shiitake mushrooms, 5g radish, 5g onion, 2g sesame oil, 1g sesame seeds, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Grind the soaked rice using a blender or mortar.
2. Finely chop the tuna flesh, shiitake mushrooms, radish, and onion.
3. Put sesame oil in a pan and fry the chopped shiitake mushrooms, radishes, and onions from step 1.
4. Add water to step 3 and cook soft rice.
5. When the rice in step 4 boils, add the chopped tuna meat and boil while stirring.
6. When the tuna meat is fully cooked, sprinkle with sesame seeds.

922.ingredients_en: 30g soaked rice, 10g button mushroom, 10g carrot, 3g onion, 5g dried seaweed, 2g sesame oil, 90g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the rice thoroughly and soak it.
2. Lightly grind 1 with a grinder.
3. Finely chop the button mushrooms and vegetables.
4. Soak the dried seaweed for about 30 minutes and finely chop it.
5. Put sesame oil in a pot and fry 2, then add 3 and 4 and fry again.
6. Add water to step 5 and boil until the rice grains spread.

923.ingredients_en: 30g soaked rice, 90g water, 25g pear, 20g spinach, 5g honey

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the rice thoroughly and soak it.
2. Grind 2 finely with a blender or mortar, add it to a pot with water, and boil.
3. Remove the peel and seeds from the pears and grate them.
4. Blanch the spinach in boiling water, then squeeze out the moisture and finely chop.
5. When 2 boils, add 3 and 4 and boil.
6. Season with honey to suit your taste.

928.ingredients_en: 10g fried tofu, 10g water parsley, 20g tofu, 15g chicken breast, 15g sliced onion, 10g sliced carrot, 5g dried shiitake mushrooms, 10g spinach, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of white pepper powder, 1g sesame salt, 1g sesame oil [Super soy sauce] 3g anchovy broth, 2g soy sauce, vinegar 2g, 1g sugar

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slightly cut off the top of the fried tofu, open the mouth to make a pouch, blanch it in boiling water and rinse it in cold water. Remove the water parsley leaves, blanch it and rinse it in cold water.
2. Squeeze out the moisture from the tofu with a cheesecloth and mash it finely. Remove the skin from the chicken and finely chop it.
3. Finely chop the onions, carrots, and soaked shiitake mushrooms. Blanch the spinach in boiling water, squeeze out the moisture, and cut into 2cm long pieces.
4. Put ingredients 2 and 3 in a bowl and season with salt, white pepper, sesame salt, and sesame oil to make dumpling filling.
5. Put the dumpling filling into the prepared tofu bag, tie it with water parsley, and steam it in a steamer for about 10 minutes.
6. Serve with vinegared soy sauce.

930.ingredients_en: 30g eggs, 5g shrimp, 3g clams, 5g sea bream meat, 3g sliced ham, 2g green onions, 10g tomatoes, 25g zucchini, 20g canned corn, 8g sliced cheese, 1g red pepper, 1g basil, 1g olive oil, 1g minced garlic, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the shell and intestines from the shrimp, lightly blanch the clams, and remove the flesh when the mouth opens.
2. Cut the seafood into 0.5cm pieces and finely chop the green onions.
3. Peel the tomatoes and cut them into pieces similar in size to the ham, and roughly chop the basil.
4. Put olive oil in a pan and stir-fry the ham and corn, then add the beaten eggs and make a scramble.
5. When 4 is half cooked, add seafood, tomatoes, and basil, garnish with red pepper, and once cooked, place in an oven-safe container.
6. Cut the cheese in step 5 into 0.5cm wide pieces, place them on a grid and bake in the oven.

931.ingredients_en: 10g potatoes, 10g cucumbers, 5g wood ear mushrooms, 15g chicken, 10g chicken broth, 50g rice, 9g green onions, 1g vegetable oil, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Dice the chicken.
2. Dice the potatoes and cucumbers and soak the wood ear mushrooms in water.
3. Put 1 in a pan with oil and stir-fry, then add chicken broth.
4. When the chicken is cooked, add potatoes and wood ear mushrooms, boil, and remove.
5. Put oil in a clean pan, add rice and chopped green onions and fry.
6. Add cucumber, cooked chicken, wood ear mushrooms, and salt to step 5 and stir-fry.

932.ingredients_en: 30g soaked rice, 35g mashed tofu, 5g black sesame seeds, 90g water, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash and soak the rice, then put it in a blender or mortar and grind it finely.
2. Finely mash the tofu.
3. Put black sesame seeds in water and filter to remove any stones.
4. Drain the water from step 3 and stir-fry, then add the same amount of water and grind finely.
5. Add rice, tofu, and an appropriate amount of water to a pot and boil over high heat.
6. Reduce the heat and when the rice spreads, add the black sesame seeds from step 2, boil further and season with salt.

940.ingredients_en: 30g sweet pumpkin, 30g sweet potato, 30g orange, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Place small stones all over the pot and place on fire until the stones become hot.
2. Cut pumpkin, sweet potato, and orange into 0.5cm thick pieces.
3. Lightly sprinkle salt on the surface of step 2.
4. Place number 3 on the heated stone.
5. Close the lid and cook over low heat until the inside is cooked.
6. Choose a sauce that suits your taste, such as salt, soybean paste sauce, or sesame sauce, and eat it.

941.ingredients_en: 20g potatoes, 15g button mushrooms, 15g carrots, 5g dried wood ear mushrooms, 10g wild yam, 1g sesame oil, 6g water starch, 6g broth, 2g cooking oil, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the carrots and potatoes into 2cm dice and cut the mushrooms into 4 pieces.
2. Blanch the wild yam in boiling water.
3. Heat a pan with oil, add carrots, potatoes, and blanched yam, stir-fry, and then add broth.
4. When the broth boils, add button mushrooms and wood ear mushrooms and season with salt.
5. Add water and starch to adjust the concentration.
6. Add sesame oil for aroma.

943.ingredients_en: 5g bamboo shoots, 5g chestnuts, 5g steamed fish cakes, 3g dried shiitake mushrooms, 5g ginkgo nuts, 5g shrimp, 1g pine nuts, 20g eggs, 1g crown crown, 50g anchovy broth, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the bamboo shoots using the comb teeth, peel the chestnuts and cut them into four pieces.
2. Slice the steamed fish cake thinly, soak the shiitake mushrooms in lukewarm water, and cut them diagonally into four pieces.
3. Beat eggs in a bowl, add 2.5 times the volume of anchovy broth, season with salt, beat well with a whisk and pass through a sieve.
4. Blanch gingko nuts, bamboo shoots, chestnuts, and shrimp in that order in boiling water.
5. Peel the blanched ginkgo nuts and remove the heads and shells from the shrimp.
6. Put the prepared ingredients in a steaming container, pour in the prepared egg water, and steam in the steamer for about 12 minutes.

944.ingredients_en: 8g fried tofu, 30g egg, 7g carrot, 50g anchovy broth, 3g soy sauce, 2g sugar, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut off the top of the fried tofu and open the mouth to make a pocket.
2. Blanch 1 in boiling water and rinse in cold water.
3. Beat eggs in a bowl, add chopped carrots and salt, and mix.
4. Add 3 to 2 and crease with a skewer to finish the ends.
5. Add anchovy broth, soy sauce, sugar, and salt to the pot.
6. Add 4 to 5 and boil for about 10 minutes.

945.ingredients_en: 50g sticky fish cake, 20g shrimp meat, 5g starch, 2g seasoning minced garlic, 1g sesame oil, 1g sesame salt, 1g rice wine, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the sticky fish cake into 2cm thick pieces and make a slit in the center.
2. Finely chop the shrimp meat.
3. Add seasoning ingredients to 2 and mix well.
4. Put starch between the sheaths of the sticky fish cake.
5. Insert number 3 between the sheaths.
6. Steam in a steaming steamer for 10 minutes.

959.ingredients_en: 125g small pumpkin, 20g minced shrimp, 20g tofu, 10g dried shiitake mushrooms, 10g chopped green bell pepper, 10g chopped red bell pepper, 5g green onion, 8g flour, 3g garlic, 1g sesame salt, 1g sesame oil, 1g salt, 1g white pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the surface of the sweet pumpkin thoroughly, remove any moisture, cut off the top of the stem, scoop out the inside with a spoon, and sprinkle salt.

2. Chop the shrimp meat, wrap the tofu in a cheesecloth to remove moisture, mash it finely, finely chop the soaked dried shiitake mushrooms, green and red bell peppers, and finely chop the green onions.
3. Mix the ingredients from step 2 together and season with salt, minced garlic, sesame salt, sesame oil, and white pepper to make the filling.
4. Remove moisture from the inside of 1.
5. Lightly sprinkle flour on the inside of 4 and make sure it is evenly coated with flour.
6. After filling with the prepared filling, cover the cut off stem with a lid and steam it in a steaming steamer for about 20 minutes, then divide into 4 to 6 pieces and serve.

965.ingredients_en:
80g beef shank, 40g king oyster mushroom, 4g flour, 1g pine nut powder
[Tteokgalbi seasoning] 5g soy sauce, 5g pear juice, 5g onion juice, 4g honey, 5g minced green onion, 3g minced garlic, 1g sesame salt, 1g sesame oil, 1g pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Finely chop the beef.
2. Add the tteokgalbi seasoning to the minced beef and knead evenly.
3. Cut the king oyster mushrooms into 1.5cm wide and 6cm long pieces and cover with flour.
4. Make tteokgalbi by wrapping 2 in 3, leaving 1cm above and below the mushrooms.
5. Cook on the pan so that it does not burn on both sides.
6. Sprinkle pine nut powder.

966.ingredients_en: 50g cabbage, 30g egg, 20g pork, 3g green onion, 2g minced ginger, 2g soy sauce, 10g wood ear mushroom, 10g chicken broth, 10g water starch, 3g cooking oil, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove the leaves from the cabbage, cut it into large pieces, and tear it along the grain into 3cm long pieces.
2. Add cabbage to a pan heated with oil, fry briefly, and remove moisture.
3. Beat the eggs and cook them in a pan.
4. Stir-fry the shredded pork in a pan, add green onions, minced ginger, and soy sauce, and stir-fry again.
5. Add wood ear mushrooms, cabbage, and eggs to step 4 and mix well.
6. Add broth, salt, and water starch to step 5.

970.name_en: Steamed fish meat balls and glutinous rice
970.ingredients_en: 30g glutinous rice, 5g gardenia, 10g spinach, 10g carrots, 100g white fish [white fish seasoning] 15g egg white, 2g ginger juice, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of white pepper powder, 3g starch

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the glutinous rice thoroughly, soak in chicha water for about 40 minutes, drain, mix with a little salt, transfer to a dry cotton cloth, and mash halfway while removing the moisture.
2. Blanch the spinach in salt water, rinse in cold water, squeeze out the water, and chop. Finely chop the carrots.
3. Squeeze out the moisture from the white fish with a cheesecloth, then finely chop it and knead it until it becomes sticky, adding ginger juice, salt, and pepper powder.
4. Add egg white and starch to step 3 and continue to knead to create stickiness, then add chopped spinach and carrots and mix.
5. Take 4 little by little, make fish balls, and then cover with 1.
6. Place a wet cotton cloth in the steamer, place the fish balls so they do not stick together, and steam for about 20 minutes.

975.ingredients_en: 10g spinach, 15g carrots, 50g flour, 10g water, 10g potatoes, 15g zucchini, 5g green onions, 200g anchovy broth, 2g minced garlic, 2g soy sauce, 1g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Place spinach and carrots in a blender with water.
2. Divide the flour in half, add spinach juice and carrot juice, add salt, and knead each.
3. Shape the dough from step 2 into round dumplings about 1.5cm in diameter.
4. Cut the potatoes and zucchini into 1.5cm dice, and cut the green onions into 2cm long pieces.
5. Add potatoes, sujebi dumplings, zucchini, minced garlic, and green onions to the anchovy broth in that order and boil.
6. Season with soy sauce and salt in step 5.

977.ingredients_en: 15g minced onion, 2g minced garlic, 1g minced ginger, 1g minced green pepper, 25g minced shrimp, 1g butter, 1g lemon juice, 3g fish broth, 2g curry powder, 3g tomato paste, 5g egg wash, 20g spring roll skin, 1g olive oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop onion, garlic, ginger, pepper, and shrimp.
2. In a buttered pan, fry the onion, ginger, garlic, pepper, and curry powder in that order.
3. Add tomato paste, lemon juice, and shrimp to step 2 and stir-fry.
4. Pour a little broth into step 3 and boil over low heat to evaporate the moisture, then place in a bowl and cool.
5. Add 4 to the spring roll skin and finish by brushing egg wash on the end.
6. Apply a little olive oil on the outside, place it on an oven pan, and bake until crispy in the oven at 170℃.

982.ingredients_en: 35g eggs, 4g green onions, 10g tomato sauce, 8g sugar, appropriate amount of salt, 2g vegetable oil, 1g sesame oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Beat eggs in a bowl.
2. Stir-fry 1 in a heated pan to make scrambled eggs.
3. Finely chop the green onions.
4. Fry 3 first in an oiled pan to release aroma, then add tomato sauce and fry.
5. Add sugar, salt, and 2 to step 4 and mix.
6. Finish by sprinkling sesame oil.

989.ingredients_en: 15g oyster mushrooms, 15g fresh shiitake mushrooms, 15g enoki mushrooms, 15g king oysters, 15g burdock, 15g dried rice cakes, 8g perilla seeds, 50g water, 2g perilla oil, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Tear the oyster mushrooms blanched in boiling water with your hands. Blanch the raw shiitake mushrooms, squeeze out the moisture, and slice them.
2. Remove the bottom of the enoki mushrooms and cut them in half, and cut the king oyster mushrooms into enoki-sized pieces.
3. Boil the joraengi rice cake in water, peel the burdock root, cut it into 3 pieces lengthwise, and cut it diagonally. Boil it in cold water several times and drain.
4. Use a spray bottle to finely grind the perilla seeds while adding water little by little. Put them through a sieve to prepare the perilla seed water and discard the residue.
5. Put perilla oil in a pot, stir-fry burdock, pour in perilla seed water, bring to a boil, then add joraengi rice cake and boil.
6. When the rice cake from step 5 floats, add mushrooms, boil for a while, and season with salt.

993.ingredients_en: 40g pork lean, 10g water starch, appropriate amount of salt, 25g spinach, 10g chives, 5g soy sauce, 5g green onion, 3g ginger, 2g cooking oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the pork into strips and season with salt and water starch.
2. Fry the seasoned meat in an oiled pan and stir to prevent it from sticking.
3. Cut the spinach and chives into 4-5cm pieces.
4. Add oil to a heated pan and add green onion, ginger, and star anise to fragrant.
5. Add 2 and soy sauce to 4 and stir-fry.
6. Add water and starch to adjust the consistency, then finally add chives and spinach.

994.name_en: Oven-roasted vegetables flavored with balsamic and rosemary
994.ingredients_en: 40g sweet pumpkin, 40g carrots, 40g beets, 40g sweet potatoes, 8g honey, 30g balsamic vinegar, 2g rosemary, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of pepper

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the pumpkin, beets, sweet potatoes, and carrots.
2. Slice 1 naturally into 2~2.5cm thick pieces.
3. Add 2, balsamic vinegar, honey, and rosemary leaves to a bowl and mix.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Bake in a preheated oven at 150℃ until cooked.
6. Turn over halfway through to cook evenly.

994.source_name_ko: 발사믹과 로즈마리로 향을 낸 오븐구이 야채

1007.ingredients_en: 40g lean pork, 30g peas, 5g water, 10g broth, 7g sugar, appropriate amount of salt, 5g starch, 3g cooking oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Clean the pork and cut it into pea-sized pieces.
2. Grind the peas finely in a blender.
3. Put 1 in a pan with oil and fry to prevent sticking.
4. Add 3 and sugar to 2 and boil.
5. Season step 4 with salt.
6. Adjust the consistency of the sauce with water starch.

1012.ingredients_en: 60g pork ribs, appropriate amount of coarse salt, 3g minced garlic, 2g minced ginger, 10g green onion, 25g tomato [seasoning sauce] 5g soy sauce, 10g water, 2g vinegar, 3g sugar, appropriate amount of sesame seeds, appropriate amount of sesame oil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Prepare pork ribs in 4cm lengths, remove fat and soak in cold water to remove blood.
2. Add coarse salt to step 1 and massage to soften the ribs, then wash off the salt.
3. Cut the pork ribs, add green onions, garlic, and ginger, blanch in boiled water, and rinse.
4. Put oil in a pot and stir-fry the blanched ribs, then pour in the seasoning sauce, cover with a lid, and stir-fry while slowly cooking.
5. Once the ribs are seasoned, stir-fry over high heat until glossy.
6. Place thinly sliced ​​tomatoes on a plate, place the stir-fried pork ribs, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

1013.ingredients_en: 50g apple, 25g yam, 10g lemon juice, 5g raisins, 5g sliced almonds, 6g sugar [Sauce] 25g yam, 40g soy milk, 5g starch syrup, 3g flour, 1g olive oil, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the unpeeled apple and the halved and peeled yam into 0.7cm dice.
2. Add lemon juice and salt to the apples and cook until soft, then add the yam and boil briefly.
3. Peel the remaining yams, cut them into pieces, and place them in a blender with soy milk, starch syrup, flour, and olive oil.
4. When 3 becomes puree, simmer over low heat until thick.
5. Mix raisins in 2, put it in a mold, spread out 4, and sprinkle sliced ​​almonds and sugar on top.
6. Bake in an oven preheated to 200℃ for about 10 minutes until the surface turns golden brown.

1015.ingredients_en: 20g clam meat, 20g cocktail shrimp, 5g green pepper, 5g red pepper, 10g green onion, 3g minced garlic, 2g minced ginger, 80g kalguksu noodles, appropriate amount of cooking oil, 4g water starch [soy sauce] 50g anchovy broth, 5g soy sauce, 5g sugar, 5g onion juice, 5g minced green onion, minced garlic 3g, 2g sesame oil, 1g sesame salt, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the clam meat and shrimp by shaking them in salt water and place them in a sieve to remove any moisture.
2. Chop the green onions, green peppers, and red peppers, and mince the garlic and ginger.
3. Boil the kalguksu noodles in boiling water, rinse in cold water, and mix with sesame oil.
4. Add the ingredients to the anchovy broth and make the soy sauce.
5. Put cooking oil in a pan and stir-fry minced garlic, ginger, and red pepper. Add clam meat, shrimp, and rice wine and stir-fry over high heat, then add soy sauce and boil.
6. When 5 is half boiled, add kalguksu noodles and stir-fry, adjusting the consistency with water starch and finishing by adding chopped green onions and sesame oil.

1019.ingredients_en: 70g white fish, 20g bamboo shoots, 15g green bell peppers, 15g red bell peppers, 10g dried shiitake mushrooms, 5g starch, 10g cheese slices, appropriate amount of sesame oil, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of white pepper [Sauce] 3g pine nuts, 4g water, 3g sugar, 3g lemon juice, 2g soy sauce, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Thinly slice the white fish, season with salt and white pepper, and then remove the moisture from the fish.

2. Cut the bamboo shoots into 5cm long pieces, blanch them in boiling water and season with salt and sesame oil. Cut the green and red bell peppers into strips of the same length and fry them in a pan while seasoning with salt.
3. Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms, cut them into thin strips, season with salt and sesame oil, fry, and cut the sliced ​​cheese into strips of the same length.

4. Lay two pieces of fish fillet from step 1 on top of each other, sprinkle starch on top, place the prepared filling on top, roll it up, then cover the outside with starch and steam it in a steamer for 8 minutes.
5. Add pine nuts, water, sugar, salt, lemon juice, and soy sauce to a blender and make the sauce until it becomes white and juicy.
6. Serve the finished steamed rice with sauce.

1020.ingredients_en: 40g beef lean, 10g carrots, 10g pickled cucumbers, 15g onions, 10g perilla leaves, 50g rice, 6g starch, appropriate amount of cooking oil [seasoned with rice] 2g sesame salt, 2g sesame oil, appropriate amount of salt [seasoned beef] 2g soy sauce, 2g sake, 1g sesame oil, appropriate amount of pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the beef into thin, palm-sized pieces and marinate in seasoning.
2. Slice the carrots and onions and fry them in a pan and season with salt.
3. Drain the cucumber pickles and cut them into strips. Wash the perilla leaves thoroughly and drain the water.
4. Cook the rice until soft, season it well, add the prepared carrots, onions, and pickled cucumbers, mix well and form into bite-sized pieces.
5. Spread the seasoned beef wide, sprinkle with starch, spread perilla leaves, and cover with prepared rice.
6. Add cooking oil to the pan, roll the rolled ssambap, and cook until the beef is cooked.

1023.ingredients_en: 30g rice, 3g sesame seeds, 4g whole almonds, 4g peanuts, 4g pumpkin seeds, 90g water, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the rice thoroughly and soak it for about 5 hours.
2. Place the soaked rice in a mortar and grind until half of the rice grains are broken.
3. Grind sesame seeds, almonds, peanuts, and pumpkin seeds in a blender.
4. Put rice and water in a pot and boil.
5. When the rice grains are cooked, add the seed powder from step 3 and boil.
6. Season with salt and serve in the prepared bowl.

1026.ingredients_en: 25g beef, 60g rice, 5g lettuce, 5g canned tuna [seasoned] a little pepper, 10g egg white, 3g soy sauce, 2g sugar, 2g starch [tuna seasoning] 3g mayonnaise, 3g chopped onion, 2g chopped celery, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of sugar, appropriate amount of pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Season the beef with salt and pepper and finely chop the green onions.
2. Remove the oil from the tuna and season with onion, celery, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, and sugar.
3. Trim the lettuce into small pieces and soak in ice water.
4. Heat oil in a pan, add minced garlic and stir-fry, then add seasoned beef and stir-fry.
5. Add sesame oil and green onion to taste in step 4.
6. Place a spoonful of rice on the drained lettuce and top with stir-fried beef, tuna, mayonnaise, and sauce in that order.

1031.ingredients_en: 20g potatoes, 20g sweet potatoes, 2g olive oil, 15g red bell peppers, 12g carrots, appropriate amount of pepper, appropriate amount of salt, 12g red onions, 25g tomatoes, 12g pumpkin, 2g parmesan cheese, 5g bread crumbs, a little basil

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the onion into rings and cut the remaining vegetables into 0.5cm dice and place them in a bowl.
2. Sprinkle salt on the vegetables in the bowl and mix until seasoned evenly.
3. Arrange vegetables neatly in an oven dish, sprinkle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
4. Add Parmesan cheese and bread crumbs to a bowl and mix well.
5. Sprinkle 4 on top of the vegetables in 3 and cover.
6. Bake in an oven preheated to 180℃.

1037.ingredients_en: 70g crab, 2g rice wine, 3g starch, 5g green onion, 2g sesame oil, 3g dried red pepper, 3g minced garlic, 2g minced ginger, appropriate amount of salt, appropriate amount of pepper powder [Seasoning sauce] 2g soy sauce, 2g rice wine, 3g sugar, 3g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the crab thoroughly with a brush, drain the water, remove the shell, cut into bite-sized pieces, and season with salt, pepper, and sake.
2. Cover with starch and steam in a steamer.
3. Slice the garlic and ginger thinly, cut the green onions into 3cm long pieces, and cut the dried peppers diagonally.
4. Heat oil in a pan and stir-fry garlic, ginger, and dried pepper.
5. When it smells spicy, add the seasoning sauce and stir-fry briefly. Add the steamed crab and stir-fry until the flavor is infused.
6. Lastly, add green onions and fragrant with sesame oil.

1039.ingredients_en: 70g broccoli, 30g beef tenderloin, 6g water starch, 10g carrots, 3g minced garlic, 3g soy sauce, 3g ginger, 3g sugar, 2g vegetable oil, appropriate amount of salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak broccoli in salt water and wash.
2. Cut broccoli into small florets, blanch in water with oil and salt, and rinse in cold water.
3. Thinly slice the ginger, carrots, garlic, and beef.
4. Season the beef and marinate for about 10 minutes, then add oil and lightly cook.
5. Put garlic, ginger, carrots, and cooked beef in a pan and stir-fry broccoli.
6. Adjust the consistency of the sauce using water and starch.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Remove blemishes from radish sprouts, shake in water, wash and drain.
2. Divide the silken tofu into appropriate sizes.
3. Mix the ingredients with the kelp broth to make cold soup, then place in the refrigerator to cool.
4. Finely chop the green pepper, red pepper, and green onion into 2cm long pieces.
5. Put the soft tofu from step 2 in the cold soup bowl and arrange the radish sprouts, shredded green onions, green and red peppers on top.
6. Pour the chilled soup into the silken tofu from step 5, top with crown crown and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

2. Slice the zucchini, tomatoes, eggplant, onion, and king oyster mushrooms and stir-fry.
3. Grill the seasoned beef.
4. Put rice on a plate, top it with green salad, then top with cooked meat and stir-fried vegetables.
5. Lastly, sprinkle dressing.

2952.ingredients_en: 10g clams, 5g seaweed, 5g low-salt soy sauce, 5g garlic, 2g sesame oil, 2g red pepper, 10g radish, 10g dried shrimp, 5g green onion, 3g seaweed powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Peel the clams and soak the seaweed for 20 minutes.
2. Add green onion, garlic, red pepper, dried shrimp, and radish to water and boil to make broth.
3. Stir-fry sesame oil, seaweed, and clams in a pot, then add low-salt soy sauce and stir-fry.
4. Add broth to the stir-fried pot and boil.

6. Put it in a soup bowl.

2957.ingredients_en: 30g clams, 10g enoki mushrooms, 3g red pepper, 1g crown crown, 3g Cheongyang pepper, 8g radish, 5g green onion, 5g kelp

6. Add diagonally sliced ​​red pepper and crown crown as garnish.

2962.ingredients_en: 50g mussels, 50g cabbage, 30g radish, 2g garlic, 3g green onion, 1g red pepper, 0.3g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add radishes cut into bite-sized pieces into boiling water.
2. When the radish becomes transparent, add the cabbage and boil.
3. Add mussels.
4. When the mussels open their mouths, add minced garlic and season.
5. Add salt.
6. Top with diagonally sliced ​​green onions and red pepper.

2967.ingredients_en: 14g beef, 15g radish, 3g green onion, 5g oyster mushroom, 5g bean sprout, 10g low-salt soy sauce, 150g water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the beef into bite-size pieces.
2. Cut the radish into bite-sized pieces.
3. Add sesame oil to the pot and fry the meat until the blood disappears.
4. When the meat is cooked, add radish and fry until transparent.
5. Pour water over medium heat and when it boils, add oyster mushrooms.
6. Add bean sprouts and green onions, boil for a while, and add low-salt soy sauce and red pepper powder.

2972.name_en: Perilla Seed Soup with Semi-Dried Pollack and Root Vegetables
2972.ingredients_en: 150g radish, 60g radish, 20g lotus root, 20g pumpkin, 10g burdock, 10g oyster mushroom, 10g shiitake mushroom, 5g green onion, 10g onion, 2g Cheongyang pepper, 1g crown crown, 1g red pepper, 1g dashi anchovy, 1g kelp, 15g perilla seed powder, 1.5g garlic, ginger 0.5g, pepper powder 0.5g, sea salt 0.2g

steps_en.instruction: 1. Finely chop ginger and garlic.
2. Wash the nose bridge and season it with minced garlic, minced ginger, salt, and pepper.
3. Boil the anchovies and kelp in a pot, then boil the broth and take it out.
4. Clean the radish, green onion, onion, lotus root, burdock, pumpkin, oyster mushroom, shiitake mushroom, and Cheongyang pepper and cut them into bite-size pieces.
5. Boil the vegetables excluding green onions, Cheongyang peppers, and crown crowns in the broth, then season with perilla seed powder and sea salt.
6. Lastly, add the kodari and boil while skimming off the foam, then add the green onion, Cheongyang pepper, and crown crown.

2977.ingredients_en: 50g bean sprouts, 40g pollack head, 10g red pepper paste, 100g flour, 5g red pepper powder, 2g salt

steps_en.instruction: 1. Mix salt with flour, knead the dough, and then age it.
2. After roasting the pollack head, boil it in cold water to make broth and strain it through gauze.
3. Pour the broth from step 2 into the pot, add 1/2 of the bean sprouts, and when it boils, add red pepper paste and red pepper powder and boil.
4. Roll out the aged sujebi dough and boil it separately in boiled water.
5. Add the sujebi from 3 and 4 and boil for a while.
6. Add the remaining bean sprouts and finish.

2991.ingredients_en:

•Broth ingredients: chicken bones (200g), kelp (3g), green onions (5g), garlic (2g), water (600g)
Seasoning: Pepper (5g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Wash the chicken meat and chicken bones thoroughly, add water, garlic, green onions, and kelp and boil the broth.
2. When the chicken meat is cooked, take it out and tear it into small pieces.
3. Slice the radish into strips, slice the green onion, red pepper, and Cheongyang pepper diagonally, and mince the onion and garlic.
4. Once the broth has boiled, strain it through a sieve.
5. Stir-fry garlic in a pot, then add chicken and stir-fry together, then add broth and prepared vegetables and boil thoroughly.
6. Finish by seasoning with pepper.

3001.ingredients_en: 3g beef (brisket), 20g radish, 30g egg, 15g green onion, 10g oyster mushroom, 10g bracken, 10g bean sprout, 10g red pepper powder, 3g perilla leaf shoot, 15g perilla seed powder, 3g salt, 3g soy sauce.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the brisket in cold water to remove blood.
2. Boil the brisket and radish in a pot, then take out the brisket.
3. Soak altorans in rice water for about 1 hour and then boil them in salt water to remove the bitter taste.
4. Clean the various vegetables and tear the brisket.
5. Add prepared vegetables and brisket to the broth and boil.
6. Add red pepper powder and perilla seed powder and boil.

3007.ingredients_en: 50g tomato, 30g tofu, 15g onion, 15g shiitake mushroom, 5g anchovy, 8g red pepper, 3g green onion, 2g kelp, 30g miso paste

steps_en.instruction: 1. Boil anchovies and kelp to make broth.
2. Cut tofu, onion, shiitake mushrooms, pepper, and green onion into bite-sized pieces.
3. Boil water in a pot and cook the tomatoes for about 5 minutes.
4. Remove the tomato skin, cut into appropriate sizes and remove seeds.
5. Dissolve miso soybean paste into the broth and add onions and shiitake mushrooms.
6. Add tomatoes and green onions.

3013.ingredients_en:
•Required ingredients: dried seaweed (2g), bonito flakes (0.3g)
Seasoning: miso (3g), mijang (0.3g), water (350g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak dried seaweed in water.
2. Finely chop the soaked seaweed.
3. Add water (350g) and bonito flakes to a pot and make broth.
4. Finely dissolve the miso paste into the broth.
5. Add seaweed to the soup and boil for a while.
6. Finish by adding mihyang.

3058.ingredients_en: 8.2g crab, 4g clam, 11.3g Korean radish, 5g peeled onion, 9.2g zucchini, 5.3g bean sprouts, 1.3g anchovy, 0.3g dried kelp, 2g peeled green onion, 1.4g soup soy sauce, 0.6g red pepper powder, 0.5g soybean paste, 0.6g red pepper paste, water 300ml

steps_en.instruction: 1. Make broth with dried anchovies and dried kelp.
2. Prepare the crabs by cutting them into bite-size pieces and peeling the clams.
3. Slice the radish into strips, cut the onion into squares, cut the zucchini into half-moon slices, and cut the green onions into diagonal slices.
4. Bean sprouts are a great meal.
5. Add radish, crab, and clams to the broth and boil for a while.
6. Add bean sprouts, onions, zucchini and green onions, boil and season to finish.

3060.ingredients_en: 50g octopus, 20g old kimchi, 40g bean sprouts, 40g radish, 5g green onions, 5g garlic, 3g dried anchovies, 5g soybean oil, 1.5g soy sauce, 300ml rice water, 5g red pepper powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Make broth with rice water and dried anchovies and take out the anchovies.
2. Slice the radish into strips, slice the green onion diagonally, and mince the garlic.
3. Rinse the aged paper in water to remove the saltiness and lightly fry it in oil.
4. Add aged paper, octopus, red pepper powder, radish, and garlic to the anchovy broth and boil.
5. Add bean sprouts, season with soy sauce, and boil.
6. Finish by adding green onions.

3062.name_en: Seaweed Soup with Yam and Perilla Seeds

steps_en.instruction: 1. Make broth again.
2. Soak the dried seaweed and chop it into small pieces.
3. Prepare the yam by removing the skin and cutting it into cubes.
4. Add sesame oil and stir-fry seaweed and garlic, then pour in broth and boil.
5. Add yam to the boiling seaweed soup and cook.
6. Add perilla seed powder and boil for a while.

3063.ingredients_en: 40g flounder meat, 20g tofu, 10g onion, 5g green onion, 1.1g pepper, 3g starch, 60g clam, 40g radish, 2g garlic, 1g crown crown, 0.1g green pepper, 0.1g enoki mushroom, 300ml water.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Chop the flounder, onions, and green onions with the thorns removed.
2. Add mashed tofu and pepper to ① and make round balls.
3. Slice the radish into strips and slice the green and red peppers diagonally.
4. Peel the clams and boil them with radish.
5. Add the meatballs to the clam broth and let it simmer slightly.
6. Lastly, add crown crown, green pepper, and enoki mushrooms to finish.

3065.ingredients_en: 1.5g dried seaweed, 40g potato, 1g minced garlic, 1g sesame oil, 2g soy sauce, 300ml water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak the seaweed in water, take it out, and remove the moisture.
2. Remove the skin from the potatoes and cut them into bite-sized pieces.
3. Put sesame oil in a pot and fry the seaweed, then add water and boil.
4. When the soup boils, add the potatoes and boil until cooked.
5. Add soy sauce and adjust seasoning.
6. Add minced garlic and boil a little more to finish.

3066.ingredients_en: 300ml water, 2g kelp, 15g onion, 30g saebang, 20g flour, 10g pumpkin, 10g radish, 5g Cheongyang pepper, 10g green onion, 5g garlic, 5g crown crown, 3g red pepper powder, 3g red pepper paste, 2g salt, 1g soy sauce.

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add kelp, onion and water to make broth.
2. Wash the saebangi by removing any impurities, add water to the flour and make the dough for hand sujebi.
3. Slice the radish and pumpkin into strips, slice the pepper and green onion diagonally, and mince the garlic.
4. Stir-fry radish, red pepper paste, and red pepper powder in a pot with perilla oil, then add broth and boil.
5. Add sabaengi, pumpkin, pepper and garlic and boil.
6. Add sonsujebi and green onions, season, and finally add crown daisy.

3067.ingredients_en: 20g cabbage, 30g tofu, 20g onion, 10g green onion, 5g anchovy, 1g Cheongyang pepper, 0.5g minced garlic, 0.5g ginger juice, 2g soybean paste, 60ml rice water, 300ml water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the cabbage, onion, and tofu into bite-sized pieces, and slice the green onion and Cheongyang pepper diagonally.
2. After pretreatment, add the remaining onion skins, green onion roots, and anchovies, boil the broth, and strain it.
3. Place tofu in boiling water for about 10 minutes to remove salt.
4. Stir-fry sesame oil and cabbage in a pot, then add rice water and broth and boil.
5. Add tofu, onion, green onion, and pepper.
6. Add soybean paste, minced garlic, and ginger juice and adjust seasoning.

3068.ingredients_en: 25g cauliflower, 2g dried seaweed, (broth) 500ml water, 2g depoly, 20g onion, 20g radish, (seasoning) 1g low-salt soy sauce, 3g dried shiitake mushrooms, 3g dried shrimp, 300ml water

steps_en.instruction: 1. Lightly fry the dipori, add water, onion, and radish and make the broth.
2. Stir-fry dried shrimp and finely grind them with dried shiitake mushrooms.
3. Cut the cauliflower into bite-size pieces and fry.
4. Add the soaked and prepared seaweed and sesame oil to the pot and stir-fry.
5. Add broth and boil thoroughly, then season with ② and low-salt soy sauce.
6. Lastly, add cauliflower to finish.

3071.ingredients_en:
•Required ingredients: dried seaweed (2g), pollack (4g)
•Broth: Dried pollack head (5g), kelp (1g), shiitake mushroom (1g), green onion (1g), water (250g)
Seasoning: sesame oil (1g), minced garlic (1g), low-sodium soy sauce (2g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Add water and broth ingredients and boil to make broth.
2. Strain the boiled broth through a sieve.
3. Soak dried seaweed and pollack in water, then cut into bite-size pieces.
4. Put sesame oil in a pot and stir-fry seaweed and pollack.
5. Add broth to the pot and boil.
6. Finish by seasoning with minced garlic and low-sodium soy sauce.

3206.ingredients_en: Cabbage (30g), green onion (12g), flounder (70g), glutinous rice powder (5g), vinegar (3g), cooking wine (5g), salted shrimp (2g), minced garlic (2g), minced green onion (2g), bay leaf (1 sheet), soaked glutinous rice (30g), fine red pepper powder (2g), white pepper (1g), finely chopped Chopped salted shrimp (1g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the cabbage into bite-sized pieces, cut the green onions into 6cm long pieces and cut them into 2 pieces, and cut the flounder into bite-size pieces.
2. Mix the seasoning evenly with the flounder and let it marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes.
3. Mix the glutinous rice ssaragi ingredients thoroughly.
4. Apply glutinous rice powder (5g) evenly to the marinated flounder and then cover it tightly with glutinous rice ssaragi.
5. Place cabbage and green onions in a steamer, place flounder on top, and steam for 12 minutes. Turn off the heat and steam for 5 minutes.
6. Place in a bowl and finish.

3220.ingredients_en: Dried greens (10g), dried shiitake mushrooms (20g), soaked rice (80g), soaked konjac rice (60g), minced pork (20g), egg (1), chamnamul (10g), soy sauce (7g), sesame oil (3g), salt (1g), cooking oil (3ml)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Soak dried herbs and dried shiitake mushrooms in hot water (200 ml) for 30 minutes.
2. Add soaked rice, konjac rice, soaked dried herbs, and water (100 ml) into the rice cooker and press the cook button to cook the rice.
3. Finely chop the soaked shiitake mushrooms, put them in a pan heated over medium heat, add minced pork, soy sauce (5g), and sesame oil (2g), fry for 3 minutes and take out.
4. Heat cooking oil (3 ml) in another pan over medium heat and add eggs to make scrambled eggs.
5. Put chamnamul in boiling water (300 ml), blanch for 1 minute, rinse in cold water, and mix with salt (1g), soy sauce (2g), and sesame oil (1g).
6. Put the konjac rice in a bowl and top with stir-fried mushrooms, meat, scrambled eggs, and seasoned chamnamul.

3223.ingredients_en: Onion (10g), chives (3g), lemon (3g), radish sprouts (20), anchovies (7-8), dried seaweed (3g), kelp (5g), rice (210g), dried chili peppers (5), pork (sirloin, 120g), poached egg (1), seaweed powder (2g), wasabi (2g), garlic (3 cloves), Ginger (1 piece), dried red pepper (3 pieces), star anise (1 piece), sesame oil (1T), pepper powder (⅓Ts), cooking oil (20ml)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the onion, slice the chives, slice the lemon, crush the garlic, slice the ginger, and coarsely crush the dried red pepper.
2. Stir-fry the anchovies in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes to remove moisture, then place them in a blender along with dried seaweed and kelp and grind until fine.
3. Add cooking oil (20 ml) and trimmed spices to a pan heated over medium heat and fry for 3 minutes to make fragrant oil.
4. Mix the sesame oil, pepper powder, and finely ground anchovy powder into the fragrant oil, then add to the rice and mix well.
5. Put the remaining fragrant oil (10g) in a pan heated over medium heat, add the pepper and pork and roast for 9 minutes. Cut the pork into thin, bite-sized pieces.
6. Place bibimbap, roasted pork, chili peppers, trimmed onion, chives, lemon, seaweed powder, wasabi, radish sprouts, and poached egg in a bowl.

3225.ingredients_en: Pork (70g), fish cake (100g), crunchy red pepper (30g), red paprika (25g), yellow paprika (25g), bean sprouts (150g), salt (0.3g), pepper powder (0.3g), oyster sauce (5g), sesame oil (1g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut pork, fish cake, crunchy pepper, and paprika into thin strips.
2. Rinse the bean sprouts in cold water and strain through a sieve.
3. Season the shredded pork.
4. Add the seasoned pork to a pan heated over medium heat and fry for 3 minutes.
5. Add the shredded ingredients and fish cake and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
6. Add oyster sauce and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, add sesame oil and mix thoroughly.

3227.ingredients_en: Onion (20g), basil (10g), boiled egg (1 piece), rice noodles (100g), tomato (200g), red pepper paste (½Ts), red pepper powder (½Ts), honey (1Ts)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the onion and basil, and cut the boiled egg in half.
2. Soak the chopped onion in cold water and drain through a sieve.
3. Add the bibim sauce ingredients to the mixer and grind them to make the bibim sauce.
4. Put rice noodles in boiling water (8 cups) and boil for 2 minutes. Rinse in cold water and strain through a sieve.
5. Finish by adding rice noodles → bibim sauce → onion, basil → egg to the bowl.

3228.ingredients_en: Abalone (2 pieces), zucchini (20g), shiitake mushrooms (15g), carrots (20g), egg fat (1 each white and yolk), boiled rice noodles (80g), cooking oil (5ml), anchovies (5g), pollack (2g), kelp (3g), green onion (100g), onion (60g), peppercorns (2g), Red pepper powder (3g), low-salt soy sauce (5g), vinegar (2g), minced green onion (1g), minced garlic (1g), sesame oil (1g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Stir-fry anchovies and pollack over low heat for 5 minutes. Add the remaining broth ingredients and water (1L), bring to a boil, boil for 30 minutes, and strain.
2. Finely chop the dried anchovies, remove the skin and intestines from the abalone, cut into pieces, and cut the zucchini, shiitake mushrooms, carrots, and egg slices.
3. Make anchovy marinade by adding the anchovy marinade ingredients to finely chopped anchovies.
4. Pour the broth into the pot and cook the cleaned abalone over low heat for 5 minutes.
5. Add cooking oil (5 ml) to a pan heated over medium heat and fry the prepared vegetables.
6. Place boiled somen in a bowl → stir-fried ingredients → cooked abalone in the following order and pour in the broth.

3233.name_en: Rolled vegetables and grilled sweet potatoes
3233.ingredients_en: Eggplant (½ + 20g), cabbage (70g), red paprika (20g), carrot (20g), bok choy (1 bunch), beaten egg (3 pieces), roasted seaweed (1 sheet), soaked rice paper (2 sheets), perilla leaves (2 sheets), steamed sweet potato (200g), milk (15g), unsalted butter (20g), minced garlic (5g), Unsalted cheese (15g), fresh cream (75g), pepper powder (0.5g), edible flowers (2 yellow), parsley powder (2g), cooking oil (35ml)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the eggplant (½) in half and hollow out the inside. Slice the remaining eggplant (20g), cabbage (50g), red paprika, and carrot into bite-size pieces. Cut the cabbage (20g) and bok choy into bite-sized pieces, and shred the egg yolk.

2. Peel the steamed sweet potatoes, mash the milk, fresh cream, and unsalted butter, mix thoroughly, fill the hollowed eggplants, top with minced garlic and unsalted cheese, and bake in an oven preheated to 180°C for 5 minutes.
3. Add cooking oil (20ml) to a pan heated over medium heat and fry the sliced ​​eggplant, cabbage, paprika, and carrots for 2 minutes.
4. Add cooking oil (15ml) to the same pan, then add bite-sized cabbage, bok choy, and pepper powder (0.5g) and fry for 3 minutes.
5. Add rice paper soaked in roasted seaweed → egg roll → perilla leaves → stir-fried and shredded vegetables, roll and cut into bite-sized pieces.
6. Place roasted eggplant in a bowl → stir-fried cabbage and bok choy → kimbap → finish by sprinkling flower petals and parsley powder (2g).

3243.name_en: Tomato vegetable soup and steamed salmon soba
3243.ingredients_en: Tomato (356g), radish (6g), carrot (6g), garlic (5g), onion (6g), salmon (100g), buckwheat noodles (70g), bay leaf (2g), salt (1g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the tomatoes (100g), radishes, carrots, garlic, and onions into small pieces, and cut the salmon into 2 long pieces.
2. Put tomatoes (250g) in a blender, then strain and simmer along with bay leaves for 3 minutes.
3. Add small-cut tomatoes, radishes, carrots, garlic, onions, and salt to the boiled tomatoes and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add water (250 ml) and boil for 5 minutes.
4. Boil the buckwheat noodles in boiling water (800 ml) for 4 minutes, rinse in cold water, and roll in the poached salmon.
5. When steam rises in a steamer lined with cotton cloth, add salmon wrapped in buckwheat noodles and steam for 3 minutes.
6. Finish by placing the tomato vegetable soup and steamed salmon soba in a bowl.

3245.ingredients_en:
Required ingredients: Chamnamul (45g), cherry tomatoes (2), spaghetti noodles (90g)
•Chamnamul pesto: Chamnamul (18g), pine nuts (4g), olive oil (4g), salt (1g)
Seasoning: Olive oil (2g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Slice the chamnamul thinly, cut the cherry tomatoes into two pieces, and finely grind the pine nuts to make pine nut powder.
2. Add the chamnamul pesto ingredients to the blender and grind to make pesto.
3. Boil spaghetti in boiling salt water (ratio of 8 cups of water to 1g of salt) for 8 minutes and drain.
4. Add pesto to spaghetti and mix.
5. Put spaghetti in a bowl, top with trimmed chamnamul and sprinkle with olive oil and pine nuts.
6. Finish with trimmed cherry tomatoes.

3246.ingredients_en: Pork (70g), tofu (50g), crunchy red pepper (30g), eggplant (60g), cooking oil (100ml), salt (0.3g), pepper powder (0.2g), soy sauce (20g), oligosaccharide (30g), vinegar (10g), starch (10g), frying powder (50g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Finely chop the pork, tofu, and crunchy red pepper, and cut the eggplant into quarters diagonally and make a slit in the center.
2. Season the minced pork and mix with the minced tofu and red pepper.
3. Fill the cut eggplant with seasoned pork and then coat it with frying powder.
4. Fry the eggplants coated in frying powder twice for 7 to 8 minutes in cooking oil (100 ml) preheated to 180℃.
5. Put eggplant sauce ingredients and water (100 ml) in a pot and boil for 4 minutes.
6. Place the fried eggplant on a bowl and sprinkle with the eggplant sauce.

3273.name_en: Braised beef and black bean sujebi
3273.ingredients_en: [ Servings for 2 ] Enoki mushrooms (½ bag), oyster mushrooms (½ handful), cabbage (½ pieces), chives (3 pieces), eggplants (½ pieces), carrots (¼ pieces), vannamei shrimp (7 pieces), scallops (4 pieces), boiled black beans (½ cup), beef (scallop meat for bulgogi, 200g), bean sprouts (⅓ handful), egg yolks (2 pieces), Crown crown (⅓ handful), mini sweet pumpkin (½ piece), fresh shiitake mushrooms (5 pieces), bok choy (2 pieces), salt (0.3 Ts), whole wheat flour (¼ cup), pork potato powder (¼ cup), brown rice flour (¼ cup), low-sodium soy sauce (2 Ts), cooking wine (0.3 Ts), honey (1 Ts), lemon juice (1 Ts), chopped chives (1 Ts), Chopped Cheongyang pepper (0.5Ts)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut off the bottoms of the enoki mushrooms and oyster mushrooms and separate them into individual pieces, cut the cabbage into bite-sized pieces, and cut the crown crown and chives into bite-sized pieces.

2. Slice the eggplant and carrots diagonally, remove the seeds and cut the sweet pumpkin into 7-8 pieces, cut the shiitake mushrooms into star shapes, wash the shrimp thoroughly, and cut the scallops into bite-sized pieces.
3. Grind boiled black beans and water (1 cup) in a blender, place in a bowl, mix thoroughly with black bean sujebi dough ingredients, knead, and ferment in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
4. Spread the beef for bulgogi, place enoki mushrooms and chives on top and roll it up.
5. Place the prepared vegetables, seafood, and bean sprouts in the bamboo steamer in that order.
6. Place the meat and mushroom rolls on top and steam over medium heat for 10 minutes. Finish with egg yolk and seasoning sauce.

3277.ingredients_en: [Serves for 2] King oyster mushroom (1 piece), onion (½ piece), tomato (2-3 pieces), eggplant (2 pieces), pork (neck meat, 200g), shredded mozzarella cheese (½ cup), olive oil (1Ts), minced garlic (2Ts), ssamjang (0.5Ts), paprika powder (a little), basil leaves (3-4 pieces)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Coarsely chop the king oyster mushrooms, onions, and tomatoes, cut the eggplants into long strips, and cut the pork into bite-sized pieces.
2. Place the eggplants in a dry pan heated over medium heat and fry until golden brown on both sides.
3. Add olive oil to the same pan, add minced garlic and fry until golden brown. Add onion and king oyster mushroom and fry until the onion becomes transparent.
4. Raise the heat to medium, add the neck meat and fry until the color changes on the outside, then add the tomatoes and mash them.
5. Add ssamjang and paprika powder and mix well. When the tomato juice comes out, tear the basil in with your hands and boil until the soup thickens.
6. Put the ingredients of ⑤ in a bowl, arrange the eggplants on top, top with cheese, and finish by cooking in the microwave until the mozzarella cheese melts.

3279.ingredients_en: [Serves for 2] Chicken (1), onion (1), green onion (1), water parsley (½ handful), king oyster mushroom (3), enoki mushroom (1 bag), garlic (6 cloves), button mushroom (4), egg (1), starch (0.7 Ts), soy sauce (0.5 Ts), salt (0.3 ts), pepper powder (a little)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Clean and prepare the chicken, and cut the onions and green onions into four pieces.
2. Cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick slices, cut off the bottoms of the enoki mushrooms and slice them into individual pieces, and cut the water parsley into bite-sized pieces.
3. Put the chicken in a pot, pour enough water to cover it, add onion, green onion, water parsley (½), and garlic, raise the heat to high and boil until the chicken is cooked.
4. Take out the chicken, onion, and water parsley, let them cool, and peel the chicken.
5. Mix chicken, onion, remaining water parsley, eggs, and starch to make chicken balls.
6. Add chicken cheeks, king oyster mushrooms, enoki mushrooms, button mushrooms, and remaining water parsley to the broth, season with seasoning, and boil for a while to finish.

3284.ingredients_en: [Serves for 2] Lettuce (3 pieces), onion (¼ piece), tomato (1 medium size), Cheongyang pepper (2 pieces), jalapeno pickle (10 piece), chicken breast (270g), sweet pumpkin (1 piece), rice paper (7 piece), plain yogurt (1 cup), garlic (3~4 cloves), green onion (½ piece), pepper powder (0.5 ts), Curry powder (1Ts)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Shred the lettuce, cut the onions and tomatoes into bite-sized pieces, and finely chop the Cheongyang peppers and jalapeno pickles.
2. Put water (10 cups), chicken breast, chicken breast boiling ingredients, and pepper powder (0.3 ts) in a pot and boil for about 7 minutes, then take out and tear into thin pieces.
3. Cut the pumpkin into 4 pieces, remove the seeds, steam in a steamer with water (1 cup), peel, and mash while adding water (1 cup).
4. Add mashed pumpkin, chicken breast, chopped Cheongyang pepper, curry powder, and pepper powder (0.2 ts) to a pan heated over low heat and stir-fry until the moisture evaporates.
5. Pour cooking oil (2 cups) into the pan, preheat over medium heat, add rice paper, fry, and take out immediately.
6. Finish by placing stir-fried pumpkin, trimmed vegetables, and plain yogurt on the fried rice paper.

3286.name_en: Tiger Shrimp Brown Rice Fried Rice
3286.ingredients_en: [Serves for 2] Broccoli (¼ pieces), onion (¼ pieces), paprika (¼ each red and yellow), chives (2 pieces), black tiger shrimp (8 pieces), brown rice (2 bowls), Cheongyang peppers (2 pieces), lemon (½ pieces), minced garlic (3 Ts), butter (3 Ts)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Separate and chop the upper part of the broccoli, finely chop the onion, paprika, and Cheongyang pepper, slice the chives into small pieces, and cut the lemon into two pieces.
2. Wash the black tiger shrimp thoroughly and remove the head.
3. Heat cooking oil in a pan over low heat, add minced garlic and stir-fry, then add onion.
4. Add the cleaned black tiger shrimp and butter and fry until the shrimp change color. Add the chopped paprika, Cheongyang pepper, and broccoli and fry for 2 minutes.
5. Put the brown rice in a bowl and sprinkle the stir-fried black tiger shrimp and broth evenly.
6. Finish by adding finely chopped chives and lemon.

3459.ingredients_en:
Based on 2 servings
• [Home convenience food ingredients] Noodle tteokbokki rice cake (20 pieces, 130g), beef brisket (110g), fish cake (1 piece, 40g), cabbage (60g), tteokbokki seasoning powder (30g)
• [Additional ingredients] Ssam tofu (100g), chives (10g), paprika (red, yellow, 30g each), cooking oil (25g), water (150g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Cut the cabbage, fish cake, and paprika lengthwise and blanch the chives once.
2. Lightly add cooking oil to the pan, fry the fish cakes, take them out, and prepare the beef brisket in the same pan.
3. Put water and noodle tteokbokki rice cake in a pot and boil. When the rice cake is cooked, take it out.
4. Add tteokbokki seasoning powder and simmer to make tteokbokki sauce.
5. Lay out the ssam tofu, top with cooked beef brisket, rice cake, prepared fish cake, paprika, and cabbage, then wrap and tie with blanched chives.
6. Finish with tteokbokki sauce.

3462.ingredients_en:
Based on 2 servings
•[Convenient food ingredients] Cabbage (40g), beef neck (50g), perilla leaves (5g), bok choy (25g), enoki mushrooms (20g), shiitake mushrooms (5g), bean sprouts (30g)
•[Additional ingredients] Squid (30g), shrimp (40g), mussels (164g), Vietnamese dried pepper (10g), tomato (250g), Cheongyang pepper (4g), onion (50g), green onion (white part, 10g), sliced garlic (10g), commercially available scorched rice (50g), tomato paste (20g), cooking oil (10g), Soy sauce (5g), red pepper powder (6g), pepper (3g), dashi pack (20g), water (4 cups = 800g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Put the dashi pack in water and boil over medium heat for 20 minutes to make broth. Peel the squid and cut it into pine cone shapes, remove the whiskers from the mussels, and peel the body of the shrimp.
2. Peel the tomatoes and cut them into 5×5mm pieces, cut the cabbage, shiitake mushrooms, Cheongyang peppers, onions, beef neck, and perilla leaves into strips, and cut the bok choy diagonally.
3. Stir-fry tomato paste in a pan, then add tomatoes and boil. Add red pepper powder and kelp broth (200ml) and boil briefly to make tomato sauce.

4. Put cooking oil in a pan and stir-fry green onions and sliced ​​garlic. Add beef neck, shrimp, squid, mussels, cabbage, onion, shiitake mushrooms, and dried pepper. Season with pepper and add soy sauce.
5. Add tomato sauce and boil for 5 minutes.
6. Add bok choy, enoki mushrooms, and bean sprouts and lightly stir-fry. Finish with perilla leaves and scorched rice.

3465.name_en: Yangjangpi Bean Noodles with Seafood Balls
3465.ingredients_en:
Based on 2 servings
• [Home meal ingredients] Shrimp (50g), squid (60g), sheep skin noodles (60g), dried wood ear mushrooms (10g), sesame oil (4g), onion (110g), stir-fry sauce (20g), creme (40g), carrots (40g), green pepper (45g), red paprika (45g), beaten egg (20g)
• [Additional ingredients] Soybean broth (1 cup = 200g), dill (1g), olive oil (35g), egg white (15g), cooking oil (700g)

steps_en.instruction: 1. Grind squid, shrimp, carrots, and onions in a blender, knead them with egg whites, make balls, and fry them in cooking oil preheated to 160 degrees for about 4 minutes.
2. Lightly fry red paprika and green pepper in olive oil.
3. Blanch the sheep’s skin noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, and blanch the dried wood ear mushrooms in the same pot.
4. Toss the sheep paste skin with sesame oil to prevent it from sticking together, roll it up and place it on a plate.
5. Place creme, blanched dried wood ear mushrooms, and beaten egg on top of the noodles, followed by fried meatballs, dill, roasted paprika, and bell peppers.
6. Pour in the soybean broth and finish with stir-fry sauce.

3570.ingredients_en:
[Main ingredients] 60g white rice, 15g mixed grains, 15g beans, 15g abalone, 15g octopus, 15g cocktail shrimp, 15g onion, 15g green onion, 10g garlic, 30g broccoli
[Seasoning] 15g turmeric powder, 30g olive oil, 3g pepper, 3g oyster sauce, 3g parsley powder

steps_en.instruction: 1. Make mixed grain rice by putting white rice, mixed grains, and beans in a rice cooker.
2. Finely chop the onion, green onion, garlic, and broccoli.
3. Blanch octopus and abalone in boiling water.
4. Finely chop the octopus and abalone.
5. Add olive oil to a heated pan and fry garlic, green onion, cocktail shrimp, octopus, abalone, onion, and broccoli in that order.
6. When the ingredients are cooked, add mixed grain rice, stir-fry with oyster sauce, turmeric powder, and pepper, and finish by sprinkling parsley powder.

3765.ingredients_en:
Main ingredients 
100g chicken thigh, 100g red onion, 10g perilla leaves, 25g lemon, 10g minced garlic, 100g somen

seasoning 
0.5g salt, 1g pepper, 130g cooking oil, 1g turmeric powder, 10g fine red pepper powder,
10g soy sauce, 60ml water, 10g cheonggukjang powder, 4g seaweed powder

steps_en.instruction:
1. Remove fat from chicken thighs.
Remove moisture with a kitchen towel.
Cut into 1.5×1.5cm pieces and add salt (0.1g).
Season with pepper and marinate for 20 minutes.

2. Chop the garlic and red onion (50g).
Cut into 1.5×1.5cm pieces.
Slice the remaining red onion (50g). Perilla leaves
Wash thoroughly and store in a wet kitchen towel.
Cut the lemon lengthwise into quarter-sized pieces.

3. Add cooking oil (40g), turmeric powder (0.5g), and finely ground turmeric to a pan.
Add red pepper powder to make red pepper oil and season it well.
Fry the chicken thighs. When the chicken thighs are cooked
Add minced garlic and diced red onion and stir-fry.
Add soy sauce, salt (0.2g), and water and simmer.

4. In another pan, add cooking oil (90g), turmeric powder (0.5g),
Add salt (0.2g) and sliced red onion (50g).
Fry over low heat and then cool.

5. Add somen to boiling water and cook for 3 minutes and 30 seconds.
After boiling, wash and rub in cold water. boiled
Roll the somen into balls and place them on a plate.
Boiled chicken thigh, cheonggukjang powder, seaweed powder
Put it on.

6. Slice the cleaned perilla leaves, add fried red onion and
Wrap it around somen together. trimmed lemon
Finish by placing the pieces.

3770.ingredients_en:
Main ingredients 
30g cabbage, 150g onion, 20g cucumber, 250g tomato,
60g red paprika, 4g Cheongyang pepper, 40g chicken breast, 5 pieces (2g) basil,
4g minced garlic, 20g bread crumbs, 100g chewy noodles

seasoning 
30g olive oil, 20g white wine vinegar, 5g red pepper paste, 0.5g salt,
5g cooking oil, 0.3g pepper powder, 10g sesame oil

steps_en.instruction:
1. Cut the cabbage and onion into thin strips, and cut the cucumber diagonally. Tomato, red paprika,
Cut the Cheongyang pepper into bite-sized pieces. Remove the fat from the chicken breast with a knife.
Remove moisture with a kitchen towel.

2. Tomatoes, red paprika, Cheongyang pepper, onion (50g), basil (4 pieces), chopped in a blender
Add garlic, olive oil (20g), white wine vinegar, red pepper paste, and salt and grind finely to make gazpacho sauce.
3. Put breadcrumbs in a pan with olive oil (10g) and fry until crispy. Put cooking oil in the same pan and add trimmed onions (100g) and fry until brown.

4. Put the trimmed chicken breast in a pot, add enough water to cover it, and boil over high heat.
When the chicken breast is cooked, let it cool, then tear it into small pieces and season with pepper powder and sesame oil.

5. Add jjolmyeon noodles to boiling water and boil.
Rinse in cold water and cool.

6. Place the noodles in a bowl and sprinkle with gazpacho sauce. trimmed cabbage, cucumber,
Finish by adding chicken breast, roasted bread crumbs, stir-fried onion, and basil (1 piece).

3773.name_en: Red pepper paste carne and K-ssambap
3773.ingredients_en:
Main ingredients 
15g chard, 20g pumpkin leaves, 95g tomatoes, 5g red pepper, 36g onions,
3g carrots, 70g beef, 5g cashew nuts, 15g unsweetened soy milk, 15g minced garlic,
20g kidney beans, 130g brown rice

Gochujang ingredients 
1g rice powder, 25ml water, 5g red pepper powder, 4g paprika powder,
3g shiitake mushroom powder, 2g meju powder, 25g pear

seasoning 
10g olive oil, 125ml water, 0.5g curry powder, 1g oregano,
3g sesame oil, 1g sesame seeds
